items.title: Election Commission sought explanation from officials as goof-up in voter list went viral
items.text: “There is a possibility of mistakes when doing any work for the first time. Out of 14,81,310 entries in the voter list, there are a total of 158 entries in which the names of the voters or their relatives appear strange. The strangeness of these names is due to such a mistake,” says statement released by Chief Electoral Officer, Uttar Pradesh
items.summary: The Election Commission sought explanations from officials after a voter list error went viral. Out of 14,81,310 entries, 158 had strange names due to a mistake.
items.title_hi: चुनाव आयोग ने अधिकारियों से स्पष्टीकरण मांगा क्योंकि मतदाता सूची में गड़बड़ी वायरल हुई
items.summary_hi: मतदाता सूची में गड़बड़ी वायरल होने पर चुनाव आयोग ने अधिकारियों से स्पष्टीकरण मांगा। 14,81,310 एंट्री में से 158 में गलती से अजीब नाम थे।

items.title: Students protest against SIR at Mumbai University, demand arrest of CEC Gyanesh Kumar
items.text: Organised by the Disha Students’ Organisation and Bhagat Singh Jan Adhikar Yatra (BSJAY), the demonstration also called for the repeal of the 2023 law governing the appointment of Election Commissioners
items.summary: Students from Disha Students’ Organisation and Bhagat Singh Jan Adhikar Yatra protested at Mumbai University against the SIR and demanded the arrest of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. They also called for repeal of the 2023 law governing the appointment of Election Commissioners.
items.title_hi: मुंबई विश्वविद्यालय में छात्रों का SIR के विरोध में प्रदर्शन, CEC ज्ञानेश कुमार की गिरफ्तारी की मांग
items.summary_hi: दिशा छात्र संगठन और भगत सिंह जन अधिकार यात्रा के छात्रों ने मुंबई विश्वविद्यालय में SIR के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन किया और मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार की गिरफ्तारी की मांग की। उन्होंने 2023 के उस कानून को रद्द करने की भी मांग की जो चुनाव आयुक्तों की नियुक्ति को नियंत्रित करता है।

items.title: Assam government to present 1st Bhupen Hazarika National Award to Usha Mangeshkar: Himanta
items.text: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will present the award at the concluding ceremony of the singer's year-long birth centenary celebrations at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi on November 29, says CM Sarma
items.summary: Assam government will present the first Bhupen Hazarika National Award to Usha Mangeshkar. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will present the award at the concluding ceremony of the singer's year-long birth centenary celebrations at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi on November 29, as per CM Sarma.
items.title_hi: असम सरकार उषा मंगेशकर को पहला भूपेन हजारिका राष्ट्रीय पुरस्कार देगी: हिमंत
items.summary_hi: असम सरकार उषा मंगेशकर को पहला भूपेन हजारिका राष्ट्रीय पुरस्कार प्रदान करेगी। प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी 29 नवंबर को नई दिल्ली के भारत मंडपम में गायिका के वर्ष भर के जन्म शताब्दी समारोह के समापन समारोह में पुरस्कार प्रदान करेंगे, ऐसा मुख्यमंत्री सरमा ने कहा।

items.title: CBI Arrests Two ED Officials In Rs 5 Lakh Bribery Case
items.text: The CBI laid a trap and allegedly caught Manoj Dwivedi red-handed while demanding and accepting Rs 5 lakh on behalf of the Enforcement Officer for extending favour to the complainant's father in the case.
items.summary: CBI arrested two Enforcement Directorate officials for allegedly accepting a Rs 5 lakh bribe. Manoj Dwivedi was caught red-handed demanding the bribe on behalf of an Enforcement Officer.
items.title_hi: CBI ने ₹5 लाख रिश्वत मामले में दो ED अधिकारियों को गिरफ्तार किया
items.summary_hi: CBI ने कथित रूप से ₹5 लाख रिश्वत लेने के लिए दो प्रवर्तन निदेशालय अधिकारियों को गिरफ्तार किया। मनोज द्विवेदी को प्रवर्तन अधिकारी की ओर से रिश्वत मांगते हुए रंगे हाथ पकड़ा गया।

items.title: Kolkata stampede: Death in the time of Durga Puja
items.text: On October 17, a stampede broke out at a Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata, claiming 19 lives. The pandal, erected in a narrow space with dim lighting, was filled with people soon after it started raining. Shrabana Chatterjee and Shiv Sahay Singh report on the lapses that led to the tragedy and the questions it has raised about accountability in West Bengal, where the new government’s first Durga Puja celebrations have been marred by controversy
items.summary: A stampede at a Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata on October 17 killed 19 people. The pandal was set up in a narrow space with dim lighting and became crowded after rain started.
items.title_hi: कोलकाता भगदड़: दुर्गा पूजा के समय मौत
items.summary_hi: उत्तर कोलकाता में एक दुर्गा पूजा पंडाल में 17 अक्टूबर को भगदड़ मच गई जिसमें 19 लोगों की मौत हो गई। पंडाल संकीर्ण जगह पर बना था और रोशनी कम थी, बारिश शुरू होने के बाद भीड़ बढ़ गई।

items.title: BJP, Shiv Sena spar as CM Fadnavis orders probe into audio clip alleging ₹500 crore deal
items.text: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has ordered a forensic investigation regarding an audio clip released recently. This audio clip claims that a BJP leader discussed a ₹500 crore payment intended to manage Maratha leader Manoj Jarange Patil. Shiv Sena's Ramdas Kadam questioned the credibility of the BJP following the allegations made in the audio. The BJP responded by warning Shiv Sena not to complicate the ruling alliance's stability.
items.summary: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis ordered a forensic probe into an audio clip that alleges a BJP leader discussed a ₹500 crore payment to manage Maratha leader Manoj Jarange Patil. Shiv Sena leader Ramdas Kadam questioned the BJP's credibility. The BJP warned Shiv Sena not to destabilize the ruling alliance.
items.title_hi: भाजपा, शिवसेना में तकरार; सीएम फडणवीस ने ₹500 करोड़ के सौदे के ऑडियो क्लिप की जांच का आदेश दिया
items.summary_hi: महाराष्ट्र के मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस ने एक ऑडियो क्लिप की फोरेंसिक जांच का आदेश दिया है जिसमें आरोप है कि एक भाजपा नेता ने मराठा नेता मनोज जारंगे पाटिल को संभालने के लिए ₹500 करोड़ के भुगतान पर चर्चा की। शिवसेना के रामदास कदम ने भाजपा की विश्वसनीयता पर सवाल उठाया। भाजपा ने शिवसेना को सत्तारूढ़ गठबंधन की स्थिरता को जटिल नहीं बनाने की चेतावनी दी।

items.title: iPhone Duo internal display break: Are iPhone Duo displays too fragile? Users report alarming cracks near hinge
items.text: Users have begun reporting instances of broken inner displays in the new iPhone Duo model. Cracks are appearing near the hinge, causing concern about the device's durability. Some owners experienced damage after minimal use, with one individual reporting a crack after just six hours. Apple is currently analyzing reported cases to determine whether there is a manufacturing issue involved.
items.summary: Users report cracks near the hinge on the new iPhone Duo's inner display. Some cracks appear after minimal use, like six hours. Apple is investigating whether it's a manufacturing issue.
items.title_hi: iPhone Duo आंतरिक डिस्प्ले टूट: क्या iPhone Duo डिस्प्ले बहुत नाजुक हैं? उपयोगकर्ताओं ने हिंज के पास दरारों की सूचना दी
items.summary_hi: उपयोगकर्ताओं ने नए iPhone Duo मॉडल के आंतरिक डिस्प्ले में हिंज के पास दरारें आने की सूचना दी है। कुछ मामलों में केवल छह घंटे के उपयोग के बाद ही दरारें आईं। Apple रिपोर्ट किए गए मामलों की जांच कर रहा है कि क्या यह निर्माण दोष है।

items.title: US Markets Today: Dow ends 600 pts lower as AI doubts persist ahead of Fed meet
items.text: US stocks ended lower after a turbulent week as fresh doubts over the AI trade weighed on sentiment. The Dow fell 1.25%, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq also declined. Investors turned their focus to major earnings from Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon, along with next week’s Federal Reserve meeting.
items.summary: US stocks fell after a turbulent week due to doubts over AI trade. The Dow dropped 1.25%, and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq also declined. Investors are watching earnings from Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon and the upcoming Federal Reserve meeting.
items.title_hi: US Markets Today: AI शंकाओं के कारण Dow 600 अंक गिरा, Fed बैठक से पहले
items.summary_hi: AI व्यापार को लेकर शंकाओं के कारण US स्टॉक्स एक उथल-पुथल भरे सप्ताह के बाद गिरे। Dow 1.25% गिरा, जबकि S&P 500 और Nasdaq भी गिरे। निवेशक Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon की कमाई और अगले सप्ताह की Federal Reserve बैठक पर नजर रख रहे हैं।

items.title: CREDAI Chennai sets up anti-corruption panel, frames SOP for reporting graft
items.summary: CREDAI Chennai has established an anti-corruption panel and created a standard operating procedure for reporting graft.
items.title_hi: CREDAI चेन्नई ने भ्रष्टाचार विरोधी पैनल बनाया, रिपोर्टिंग के लिए SOP तैयार किया
items.summary_hi: CREDAI चेन्नई ने भ्रष्टाचार विरोधी पैनल का गठन किया है और भ्रष्टाचार की शिकायत के लिए मानक संचालन प्रक्रिया बनाई है।

items.title: Gangster Himanshu Bhau, Wanted In India For Multiple Murders, Arrested In US
items.text: Himanshu Bhau, a rival of jailed gangster Lawrence Bishnoi, was on the most-wanted lists of Haryana and Delhi Police. Murders, kidnappings, extortions -- a number of cases have been registered against him.
items.summary: Gangster Himanshu Bhau, wanted in India for multiple murders and a rival of Lawrence Bishnoi, was arrested in the US. He was on the most-wanted lists of Haryana and Delhi Police with cases of murders, kidnappings, and extortions.
items.title_hi: गैंगस्टर हिमांशु भाऊ, भारत में कई हत्याओं के लिए वांछित, अमेरिका में गिरफ्तार
items.summary_hi: गैंगस्टर हिमांशु भाऊ, जो भारत में कई हत्याओं के लिए वांछित था और लॉरेंस बिश्नोई का प्रतिद्वंद्वी था, को अमेरिका में गिरफ्तार किया गया। वह हरियाणा और दिल्ली पुलिस की मोस्ट-वांटेड सूची में था और उस पर हत्या, अपहरण और जबरन वसूली के कई मामले दर्ज हैं।

items.title: Tata Motors CV posts Rs 2,138 crore Q2 profit
items.text: Tata Motors Ltd achieved a standalone net profit of ₹2,138 crore for the September quarter, reversing last year's loss. Revenue from operations rose significantly to ₹23,930 crore, up 42% from the previous year. Improved demand was driven by higher fleet utilization and industrial activity, according to managing director Girish Wagh. Consolidated profit also increased to ₹1,257 crore, aided by a drop in mark-to-market losses.
items.summary: Tata Motors posted a standalone net profit of ₹2,138 crore for the September quarter, reversing last year's loss. Revenue rose 42% to ₹23,930 crore, driven by higher fleet utilization and industrial activity.
items.title_hi: टाटा मोटर्स सीवी ने दूसरी तिमाही में ₹2,138 करोड़ का लाभ दर्ज किया
items.summary_hi: टाटा मोटर्स ने सितंबर तिमाही में ₹2,138 करोड़ का स्टैंडअलोन शुद्ध लाभ दर्ज किया, जिससे पिछले साल का घाटा उलट गया। राजस्व 42% बढ़कर ₹23,930 करोड़ हो गया, जो उच्च बेड़े उपयोग और औद्योगिक गतिविधि से प्रेरित था।

items.title: Congress MP Imran Masood, 9 others detained near Jamia amid student protest
items.text: Jamia protests: Ten individuals were detained by Delhi Police near Jamia Millia Islamia amid ongoing protests. The protests began on October 12 and demand students' union elections. Students claim that the last elections were held in 2005, after which the union was dissolved. Tensions escalated on October 17 when authorities attempted to remove demonstrators from campus property. University security has since been tightened with students being checked prior to entry.
items.summary: Congress MP Imran Masood and nine others were detained by Delhi Police near Jamia Millia Islamia during student protests demanding union elections. The protests began on October 12 and escalated on October 17 when authorities tried to remove demonstrators. University security has been tightened with checks on students entering campus.
items.title_hi: कांग्रेस सांसद इमरान मसूद और 9 अन्य जामिया के पास छात्र विरोध के दौरान हिरासत में लिए गए
items.summary_hi: कांग्रेस सांसद इमरान मसूद और नौ अन्य लोगों को दिल्ली पुलिस ने जामिया मिलिया इस्लामिया के पास छात्र विरोध प्रदर्शन के दौरान हिरासत में लिया। विरोध 12 अक्टूबर को शुरू हुआ और 17 अक्टूबर को तब बढ़ गया जब अधिकारियों ने प्रदर्शनकारियों को परिसर से हटाने की कोशिश की। विश्वविद्यालय की सुरक्षा कड़ी कर दी गई है और छात्रों की प्रवेश से पहले जांच की जा रही है।

items.title: Godrej Properties' Q2FY27 results: Net profit falls 62% to ₹154 crore
items.text: Record first-half bookings and higher cash collections offset weak quarterly earnings, as total income rises 38% year-on-year
items.summary: Godrej Properties' net profit fell 62% to ₹154 crore in Q2FY27. Total income rose 38% year-on-year, driven by record first-half bookings and higher cash collections.
items.title_hi: गोदरेज प्रॉपर्टीज Q2FY27 परिणाम: शुद्ध लाभ 62% गिरकर ₹154 करोड़
items.summary_hi: गोदरेज प्रॉपर्टीज का Q2FY27 में शुद्ध लाभ 62% गिरकर ₹154 करोड़ रहा। कुल आय साल-दर-साल 38% बढ़ी, जिसे रिकॉर्ड पहली छमाही बुकिंग और अधिक नकद संग्रह का समर्थन मिला।

items.title: Commerce minister Piyush Goyal discusses investment avenues with German companies
items.text: Piyush Goyal engaged with major German firms like Siemens Healthineers, Bayer, and Fresenius to discuss investments. He highlighted Bayer's plans for expansion and collaboration in India's healthcare ecosystem. Goyal also addressed opportunities for Fresenius to leverage India's talent for healthcare solutions. Furthermore, he explored ways to strengthen Siemens Healthineers' presence in the country. These discussions reflect India's growing relevance in the global healthcare market.
items.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal met with German companies Siemens Healthineers, Bayer, and Fresenius to discuss investment opportunities. The talks focused on healthcare sector collaboration and leveraging India's talent pool.
items.title_hi: वाणिज्य मंत्री पीयूष गोयल ने जर्मन कंपनियों के साथ निवेश पर चर्चा की
items.summary_hi: वाणिज्य मंत्री पीयूष गोयल ने सिमेंस हेल्थिनियर्स, बेयर और फ्रेसेनियस जैसी जर्मन कंपनियों के साथ निवेश अवसरों पर बातचीत की। चर्चा स्वास्थ्य सेवा क्षेत्र में सहयोग और भारत की प्रतिभा के उपयोग पर केंद्रित थी।

items.title: Target reached, but asset monetisation to continue: DIPAM secretary Arunish Chawla
items.text: "We have already identified a cluster of 10 national highways, which will provide the underlying capital asset. So, the second public InvITs is in the works and hopefully before the close of this financial year, it will also come to fruition," Chawla said. "We are also bringing down the equity (stake) in nationalised banks gradually to the minimum public shareholding norm of 75%, that is part of the mandate that we have to share the wealth with the people and also in line with regulations...we are moving ahead on that path."
items.summary: The DIPAM secretary said the asset monetisation target has been reached but the programme will continue. A second public InvIT backed by 10 national highways is being prepared for this financial year. The government is also gradually reducing its equity in nationalised banks to the 75% minimum public shareholding norm.
items.title_hi: लक्ष्य पूरा, पर संपत्ति मुद्रीकरण जारी: DIPAM सचिव अरुणीश चावला
items.summary_hi: DIPAM सचिव ने कहा कि संपत्ति मुद्रीकरण का लक्ष्य पूरा हो गया है लेकिन कार्यक्रम जारी रहेगा। 10 राष्ट्रीय राजमार्गों द्वारा समर्थित दूसरा सार्वजनिक InvIT इस वित्त वर्ष के लिए तैयार किया जा रहा है। सरकार राष्ट्रीयकृत बैंकों में अपनी इक्विटी को धीरे-धीरे 75% न्यूनतम सार्वजनिक शेयरधारिता मानदंड तक कम कर रही है।

items.title: 5 Killed In Explosion At House Storing Firecrackers In Bihar
items.text: A Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL) team has arrived at the scene; the fire has been completely extinguished, and a thorough search of the entire house is underway.
items.summary: Five people were killed in an explosion at a house storing firecrackers in Bihar. A Forensic Science Laboratory team has arrived, the fire is extinguished, and a thorough search of the house is underway.
items.title_hi: बिहार में पटाखे रखने वाले घर में विस्फोट से 5 की मौत
items.summary_hi: बिहार में पटाखे रखने वाले घर में विस्फोट से पांच लोगों की मौत हो गई। फोरेंसिक साइंस लेबोरेटरी (FSL) की टीम मौके पर पहुंची, आग पूरी तरह बुझा दी गई है और पूरे घर की गहन तलाशी जारी है।

items.title: Keralam offers to host Priyanka Gandhi’s son Raihan Vadra’s full photo exhibition
items.text: Following the removal of photos from Raihan Vadra's exhibition, prominent Congress leaders expressed their discontent. Kerala's Chief Minister V D Satheesan offered to host the complete exhibition without exclusions. The AICC criticized the removal, emphasizing that inviting Raihan Vadra is acceptable. Congress spokesperson Pawan Khera highlighted the government's attempts to suppress artistic expression related to protests. This incident has generated significant political discourse within the Congress party.
items.summary: After photos were removed from Raihan Vadra's exhibition, Congress leaders expressed discontent. Kerala Chief Minister V D Satheesan offered to host the full exhibition without exclusions. The AICC criticized the removal, and Congress spokesperson Pawan Khera highlighted government attempts to suppress artistic expression related to protests, generating political discourse within the Congress party.
items.title_hi: केरलम ने प्रियंका गांधी के बेटे रेहान वाड्रा की पूरी फोटो प्रदर्शनी की मेजबानी की पेशकश की
items.summary_hi: रेहान वाड्रा की प्रदर्शनी से फोटो हटाए जाने के बाद कांग्रेस नेताओं ने नाराजगी जताई। केरल के मुख्यमंत्री वी डी सथीसन ने बिना किसी बहिष्करण के पूरी प्रदर्शनी की मेजबानी की पेशकश की। AICC ने हटाने की आलोचना की, और कांग्रेस प्रवक्ता पवन खेड़ा ने विरोध से जुड़ी कलात्मक अभिव्यक्ति को दबाने के सरकारी प्रयासों को उजागर किया, जिससे कांग्रेस पार्टी में राजनीतिक चर्चा शुरू हो गई।

items.title: 14 Indians Safe After Boat Got Involved In Incident Off Yemen Coast: Embassy
items.text: Randhir Jaiswal said this at his bi-weekly media briefing when asked about the reports that some Houthis have helped save Indians who were on a boat.
items.summary: The Indian Embassy confirmed that 14 Indians are safe after their boat was involved in an incident off the Yemen coast. Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said Houthis helped save the Indians on board.
items.title_hi: यमन तट पर नाव घटना के बाद 14 भारतीय सुरक्षित: दूतावास
items.summary_hi: भारतीय दूतावास ने पुष्टि की कि यमन तट पर एक घटना में शामिल नाव पर सवार 14 भारतीय सुरक्षित हैं। प्रवक्ता रंधीर जायसवाल ने कहा कि हूथियों ने नाव पर सवार भारतीयों को बचाने में मदद की।

items.title: US data centre spending seen more than doubling to $2.1 trillion by 2028, estimates BoFA
items.text: Global data centre spending is expected to reach $1 trillion in 2026 and more than double to $2.1 trillion by 2028, driven by rising demand for AI services, BofA Global Research estimates. The data centre market could reach $2.93 trillion by 2030 as AI fuels rapid infrastructure expansion.
items.summary: Global data centre spending is expected to reach $1 trillion in 2026 and more than double to $2.1 trillion by 2028, driven by AI demand. BofA Global Research estimates the market could reach $2.93 trillion by 2030.
items.title_hi: अमेरिकी डेटा सेंटर खर्च 2028 तक $2.1 ट्रिलियन से अधिक दोगुना होने का अनुमान, BoFA के अनुसार
items.summary_hi: वैश्विक डेटा सेंटर खर्च 2026 तक $1 ट्रिलियन और 2028 तक $2.1 ट्रिलियन से अधिक होने की उम्मीद है, जो AI मांग से प्रेरित है। BofA ग्लोबल रिसर्च का अनुमान है कि बाजार 2030 तक $2.93 ट्रिलियन तक पहुंच सकता है।

items.title: Congress urges PM Modi to clarify Arunachal border situation
items.text: Congress has urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to brief Parliament and the nation on the border situation in Arunachal Pradesh, with party president Mallikarjun Kharge questioning whether India's patrolling access has been compromised.
items.summary: Congress has urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to brief Parliament and the nation on the border situation in Arunachal Pradesh. Party president Mallikarjun Kharge questioned whether India's patrolling access has been compromised.
items.title_hi: कांग्रेस ने PM मोदी से अरुणाचल सीमा स्थिति स्पष्ट करने को कहा
items.summary_hi: कांग्रेस ने प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी से संसद और देश को अरुणाचल प्रदेश की सीमा स्थिति के बारे में जानकारी देने का आग्रह किया है। पार्टी अध्यक्ष मल्लिकार्जुन खड़गे ने सवाल किया कि क्या भारत की गश्ती पहुंच से समझौता किया गया है।

items.title: Ladakh SEC puts draft delimitation plan in public, seeks feedback
items.text: On October 21, Ladakh Lieutenant Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena notified 100 constituencies for the eight LAHDCs, nearly doubling the existing strength of 52 seats. Under the new structure notified through the LAHDC (Amendment) Regulation, 2026, Leh will have 22 constituencies, Kargil 21, Sankoo 13, Changthang 10, Nubra, Sham and Zanskar nine each, and Drass seven.
items.summary: Ladakh's State Election Commission has published a draft delimitation plan for public feedback. The plan proposes 100 constituencies across eight LAHDCs, nearly double the current 52 seats.
items.title_hi: लद्दाख SEC ने मसौदा परिसीमन योजना सार्वजनिक की, प्रतिक्रिया मांगी
items.summary_hi: लद्दाख के राज्य चुनाव आयोग ने जनता की राय के लिए मसौदा परिसीमन योजना जारी की है। योजना में आठ LAHDC के लिए 100 निर्वाचन क्षेत्र प्रस्तावित हैं, जो मौजूदा 52 सीटों से लगभग दोगुना हैं।

items.title: Mother of all IPOs! Jio Platforms shatters many existing records - Full list here
items.text: Jio Platforms’ ₹30,188-crore IPO became India’s largest, drawing bids of ₹4.72 lakh crore and more than 13.8 million applications. Strong demand across retail and institutional investors set records, with the company valued at up to ₹10.3 lakh crore ahead of its stock market debut.
items.summary: Jio Platforms' ₹30,188-crore IPO became India's largest, attracting bids worth ₹4.72 lakh crore and over 13.8 million applications. The company was valued at up to ₹10.3 lakh crore before its market debut.
items.title_hi: सभी IPOs की माँ! Jio Platforms ने कई मौजूदा रिकॉर्ड तोड़े - पूरी सूची यहाँ
items.summary_hi: Jio Platforms का ₹30,188 करोड़ का IPO भारत का सबसे बड़ा बना, जिससे ₹4.72 लाख करोड़ की बोलियाँ और 13.8 मिलियन से अधिक आवेदन प्राप्त हुए। कंपनी का मूल्यांकन बाजार में आने से पहले ₹10.3 लाख करोड़ तक आंका गया।

items.title: Periodic Labour Force Survey to expand coverage to capture unpaid household, volunteers from January 2027
items.text: From January 2027, the Periodic Labour Force Survey will include unpaid household activities and digital platform workers. New questions will identify individuals engaged in caregiving and relevant unpaid volunteer work in both urban and rural settings. This expansion aims to enhance the measurement of labour-market data. The survey will enable better reporting and data collection on these aspects annually.
items.summary: From January 2027 the Periodic Labour Force Survey will include unpaid household activities and digital platform workers. New questions will identify people engaged in caregiving and unpaid volunteer work in urban and rural areas. The expansion aims to improve labour-market data measurement.
items.title_hi: आवधिक श्रम बल सर्वेक्षण जनवरी 2027 से अवैतनिक घरेलू कार्य, स्वयंसेवकों को शामिल करेगा
items.summary_hi: जनवरी 2027 से आवधिक श्रम बल सर्वेक्षण में अवैतनिक घरेलू गतिविधियां और डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म कर्मचारी शामिल होंगे। नए प्रश्न शहरी और ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में देखभाल और अवैतनिक स्वयंसेवी कार्य में लगे लोगों की पहचान करेंगे। इस विस्तार का उद्देश्य श्रम बाजार डेटा माप में सुधार करना है।

items.title: College Student Accuses TVK Worker Of Sexual Assault, Then A U-turn
items.text: DMK MP Kanimozhi Karunanidhi questioned Chief Minister Vijay about the action he would take against his party functionary.
items.summary: A college student accused a TVK worker of sexual assault but later made a U-turn. DMK MP Kanimozhi Karunanidhi questioned Chief Minister Vijay about action against his party functionary.
items.title_hi: कॉलेज छात्रा ने TVK कार्यकर्ता पर यौन उत्पीड़न का आरोप लगाया, फिर यू-टर्न लिया
items.summary_hi: एक कॉलेज छात्रा ने TVK कार्यकर्ता पर यौन उत्पीड़न का आरोप लगाया लेकिन बाद में यू-टर्न ले लिया। DMK सांसद कनिमोझी करुणानिधि ने मुख्यमंत्री विजय से उनके पार्टी पदाधिकारी के खिलाफ कार्रवाई के बारे में सवाल किया।

items.title: IndiGo Extends Saudi Flight Cancellations Till October 27 Amid Houthi Attacks
items.text: The flight disruptions come amid escalating drone and missile strikes targeting Saudi Arabia's airports, energy installations and other critical infrastructure, with Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis having been involved in a prolonged campaign against the country.
items.summary: IndiGo has extended its Saudi Arabia flight cancellations until October 27. The disruptions are due to ongoing drone and missile attacks by Yemen's Houthis on Saudi airports and infrastructure.
items.title_hi: इंडिगो ने सऊदी उड़ानें रद्द कीं 27 अक्टूबर तक, हूती हमलों के कारण
items.summary_hi: इंडिगो ने सऊदी अरब की उड़ानें 27 अक्टूबर तक रद्द कर दी हैं। यह व्यवधान यमन के हूती विद्रोहियों द्वारा सऊदी हवाई अड्डों और बुनियादी ढांचे पर ड्रोन और मिसाइल हमलों के कारण हो रहा है।

items.title: WazirX shifts focus to recovery, AI after year of rebuilding: Shetty
items.text: A year after restarting operations, WazirX is focusing on recovering value for customers and creditors, rebuilding trust and using AI tools to improve trading outcomes.
items.summary: After a year of rebuilding, WazirX is focusing on recovering value for customers and creditors, rebuilding trust, and using AI tools to improve trading outcomes.
items.title_hi: WazirX ने पुनर्निर्माण के एक साल बाद रिकवरी, AI पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया: शेट्टी
items.summary_hi: परिचालन फिर से शुरू करने के एक साल बाद, WazirX ग्राहकों और लेनदारों के लिए मूल्य वसूली, विश्वास पुनर्निर्माण और ट्रेडिंग परिणामों को बेहतर बनाने के लिए AI टूल का उपयोग करने पर ध्यान केंद्रित कर रहा है।

items.title: Sebi mulls automatic approval for investments, activities by exchanges
items.text: Sebi has proposed an automatic approval route for certain activities and investments by market infrastructure institutions, subject to financial limits and governance safeguards.
items.summary: Sebi has proposed an automatic approval route for certain activities and investments by market infrastructure institutions, with financial limits and governance safeguards.
items.title_hi: सेबी एक्सचेंजों द्वारा निवेश और गतिविधियों के लिए स्वत: मंजूरी पर विचार कर रहा है
items.summary_hi: सेबी ने बाजार अवसंरचना संस्थानों द्वारा कुछ गतिविधियों और निवेशों के लिए स्वत: मंजूरी का मार्ग प्रस्तावित किया है, जो वित्तीय सीमाओं और गवर्नेंस सुरक्षा उपायों के अधीन है।

items.title: Andhra Pradesh local poll row: YSRCP alleges attacks, seeks central forces
items.text: TDP filed complaints before the SEC against alleged violence by YSRCP to stall local body election process. Following the SC directive, the SEC ruled that candidates in four of 19 municipalities will be given more time. Addressing a press conference, former chief minister and YSRCP president YS Jagan Mohan Reddy said that the Naidu-led government was not honouring the SC directive and was going ahead with the anarchy in the local body elections.
items.summary: YSRCP has alleged attacks on its candidates and requested central forces for Andhra Pradesh local body elections. The SEC has granted more time to candidates in four of 19 municipalities following a Supreme Court directive.
items.title_hi: आंध्र स्थानीय चुनाव विवाद: YSRCP ने हमलों का आरोप लगाया, केंद्रीय बल मांगे
items.summary_hi: YSRCP ने अपने उम्मीदवारों पर हमले का आरोप लगाया है और आंध्र प्रदेश स्थानीय निकाय चुनावों के लिए केंद्रीय बलों की मांग की है। सुप्रीम कोर्ट के निर्देश पर SEC ने 19 में से चार नगरपालिकाओं के उम्मीदवारों को अधिक समय दिया है।

items.title: BPCL Q2 Results: Profit Swings To Rs 4,993 Crore From Loss, EBITDA Rebounds
items.summary: BPCL's profit swung to ₹4,993 crore in Q2 from a loss in the previous year, and EBITDA rebounded.
items.title_hi: BPCL Q2 परिणाम: लाभ ₹4,993 करोड़ पर पहुंचा, EBITDA में सुधार
items.summary_hi: BPCL का Q2 में लाभ ₹4,993 करोड़ रहा, जो पिछले साल के नुकसान से उछाल है, और EBITDA में सुधार हुआ।

items.title: India to remain strict on quality: Industry minister Piyush Goyal
items.text: India's Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal emphasised a strict stance on quality and environmental regulations. He noted that many companies are eager to invest in India across various sectors. Goyal mentioned India's advantages in decarbonisation amidst competition from Europe’s carbon border adjustment mechanism. Discussions on free trade agreements indicate significant potential for job creation in India.
items.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal says India will remain strict on quality and environmental regulations. He notes many companies want to invest in India, and highlights India's decarbonisation advantages. Free trade agreement talks show significant job creation potential.
items.title_hi: भारत गुणवत्ता पर सख्त रहेगा: उद्योग मंत्री पीयूष गोयल
items.summary_hi: वाणिज्य मंत्री पीयूष गोयल कहते हैं कि भारत गुणवत्ता और पर्यावरण नियमों पर सख्त रहेगा। उन्होंने नोट किया कि कई कंपनियां भारत में विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में निवेश करने को उत्सुक हैं। गोयल ने यूरोप के कार्बन बॉर्डर एडजस्टमेंट मैकेनिज्म की प्रतिस्पर्धा के बीच भारत के डीकार्बोनाइजेशन लाभों का उल्लेख किया। मुक्त व्यापार समझौतों पर चर्चा भारत में महत्वपूर्ण रोजगार सृजन क्षमता दर्शाती है।

items.title: Coforge Q2 results: Net profit surges 56.5% to ₹588 cr, revenue up 53.6%
items.text: Coforge posted a 56.5 per cent increase in consolidated profit to Rs 588 crore in the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, driven by AI-led execution of deals, the company said on Friday. The IT firm had posted a net profit of Rs 375.8 crore in the same period a year ago. "Right now the margin uptake that we are seeing is in the existing fixed price projects where AI is getting infused," Coforge Chief Executive Officer and Executive Director, Sudhir Singh, said during the company's earnings call. Coforge signed 8 large deals the highest number signed in a single quarter across North Americ
items.summary: Coforge's net profit jumped 56.5% to ₹588 crore in Q2, up from ₹375.8 crore a year earlier. Revenue rose 53.6%. The company signed 8 large deals, its highest in a quarter, driven by AI-led execution.
items.title_hi: Coforge Q2 परिणाम: शुद्ध लाभ 56.5% बढ़कर ₹588 करोड़, राजस्व 53.6% बढ़ा
items.summary_hi: Coforge का शुद्ध लाभ Q2 में 56.5% बढ़कर ₹588 करोड़ हुआ, जो पिछले साल ₹375.8 करोड़ था। राजस्व 53.6% बढ़ा। कंपनी ने 8 बड़े सौदे किए, जो एक तिमाही में सबसे अधिक हैं, AI के कारण।

items.title: Coforge Q2 results: Net profit surges 56.5% to ₹588 cr, revenue up 53.6%
items.summary: Coforge's Q2 net profit surged 56.5% to ₹588 crore, and revenue increased 53.6%.
items.title_hi: Coforge Q2 परिणाम: शुद्ध लाभ 56.5% बढ़कर ₹588 करोड़, राजस्व 53.6% ऊपर
items.summary_hi: Coforge का Q2 शुद्ध लाभ 56.5% बढ़कर ₹588 करोड़ हो गया, और राजस्व 53.6% बढ़ा।

items.title: Rishikesh–Karnaprayag rail line to have 16 tunnels: How India’s homegrown technology is advancing Himalayan connectivity
items.text: India is expanding its domestic tunnel boring machine (TBM) manufacturing capabilities as construction advances on the 125-km Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway line.
items.summary: The Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway line will have 16 tunnels. India is expanding its domestic tunnel boring machine manufacturing as construction progresses on the 125-km line.
items.title_hi: ऋषिकेश–कर्णप्रयाग रेल लाइन में 16 सुरंगें होंगी: भारत की स्वदेशी तकनीक कैसे हिमालयी संपर्क को आगे बढ़ा रही है
items.summary_hi: ऋषिकेश–कर्णप्रयाग रेलवे लाइन में 16 सुरंगें होंगी। भारत 125 किलोमीटर लंबी लाइन के निर्माण के साथ घरेलू टनल बोरिंग मशीन (TBM) निर्माण क्षमताओं का विस्तार कर रहा है।

items.title: Sebi eases call-recording mandate for research analysts dealing with funds
items.text: Market regulator Sebi on Friday eased the mandatory requirement for research analysts to maintain call recordings of their interactions with institutional investors to reduce compliance burden and improve ease of doing business. In a circular, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) said research analysts and entities will no longer be mandatorily required to maintain call recordings of interactions with institutional investors. However, they will continue to be required to maintain records of their interactions with all clients, including prospective clients, through means such as s
items.summary: Sebi has eased the mandatory call-recording requirement for research analysts interacting with institutional investors to reduce compliance burden. Analysts must still maintain records of interactions with all clients through other means.
items.title_hi: सेबी ने फंड से जुड़े शोध विश्लेषकों के लिए कॉल रिकॉर्डिंग अनिवार्यता में ढील दी
items.summary_hi: सेबी ने संस्थागत निवेशकों के साथ बातचीत की कॉल रिकॉर्डिंग रखने की अनिवार्य आवश्यकता को कम किया ताकि अनुपालन बोझ कम हो। विश्लेषकों को अभी भी सभी ग्राहकों के साथ बातचीत के रिकॉर्ड अन्य माध्यमों से रखने होंगे।

items.title: FSDC stresses on vigilance, reforms amid global uncertainty & AI boom
items.text: Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman led an important session of the Financial Stability and Development Council, focusing on maintaining financial stability amidst looming geopolitical tensions and fluctuating global bond yields. Key topics included fostering a robust domestic investment climate, ensuring effective capital movement for reform, and addressing cybersecurity needs within the financial sector.
items.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman led an FSDC session focusing on financial stability amid geopolitical tensions and fluctuating global bond yields. Key topics included fostering a robust domestic investment climate, ensuring effective capital movement for reform, and addressing cybersecurity needs in the financial sector.
items.title_hi: FSDC ने वैश्विक अनिश्चितता और AI उछाल के बीच सतर्कता, सुधारों पर जोर दिया
items.summary_hi: वित्त मंत्री निर्मला सीतारमण ने FSDC की एक महत्वपूर्ण बैठक की अध्यक्षता की, जिसमें भू-राजनीतिक तनाव और उतार-चढ़ाव वाले वैश्विक बॉन्ड यील्ड के बीच वित्तीय स्थिरता बनाए रखने पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया गया। मुख्य विषयों में मजबूत घरेलू निवेश माहौल को बढ़ावा देना, सुधार के लिए प्रभावी पूंजी आवाजाही सुनिश्चित करना और वित्तीय क्षेत्र में साइबर सुरक्षा जरूरतों को संबोधित करना शामिल था।

items.title: Apple India revenue grows 32% to cross ₹1 trillion mark in FY26: Tofler
items.text: iPhone maker Apple's India revenue grew by over 32 per cent to Rs 1,04,607 crore in FY26, according to the document shared by market intelligence firm Tofler. The company recorded revenue of Rs 79,060.5 crore in FY25. "Apple India Private Limited provides and markets Apple brand products and software, and reported its revenues for the financial year 2025-26 at Rs 1,04,607 crore, a 32 per cent jump since the last financial year," Tofler said. Apple India net profit grew by 66 per cent to Rs 5,311 crore in the same fiscal. The company's total expenses for the fiscal were reported at Rs 96,224 cr
items.summary: Apple India's revenue grew 32% to Rs 1,04,607 crore in FY26. Net profit rose 66% to Rs 5,311 crore. Total expenses were Rs 96,224 crore.
items.title_hi: Apple India का राजस्व 32% बढ़ा, FY26 में ₹1 लाख करोड़ पार: Tofler
items.summary_hi: Apple India का राजस्व FY26 में 32% बढ़कर ₹1,04,607 करोड़ हो गया। शुद्ध लाभ 66% बढ़कर ₹5,311 करोड़ रहा। कुल खर्च ₹96,224 करोड़ थे।

items.title: SEBI orders Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy to refund ₹546 crore; imposes ₹11.5 crore penalty

items.title: US Treasury yields rise but 10-year stays below 5% as AI jitters persist
items.text: US Treasury yields rise after a sharp drop in the previous session, but the benchmark 10 year yield stays below 5% as lingering AI market concerns keep investors cautious. Strong economic activity and sticky inflation remain key factors for bond markets, while expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike next week weaken further.

items.title_hi: अमेरिकी ट्रेजरी यील्ड बढ़ीं लेकिन 10-वर्षीय 5% से नीचे रही क्योंकि AI चिंताएं बनी हुई हैं

items.title: Strong macro fundamentals, policy interventions to anchor eco against global headwinds: RBI bulletin
items.text: Strong macroeconomic fundamentals continue to support the Indian economy against global inflation and trade tensions. Recent geopolitical frictions have resulted in increased prices and supply chain issues, leading to policy changes. Currency fluctuations were observed, but measures by the Reserve Bank helped stabilize the rupee recently. Foreign Direct Investment remains robust, driven by significant inflows from major sources like the US and Singapore.
items.summary: The RBI bulletin says strong macro fundamentals and policy interventions are anchoring the economy against global headwinds. Geopolitical frictions have caused price increases and supply chain issues, but RBI measures stabilized the rupee. FDI remains robust with inflows from the US and Singapore.
items.title_hi: मजबूत मैक्रो फंडामेंटल्स, नीतिगत हस्तक्षेप वैश्विक प्रतिकूलताओं के खिलाफ अर्थव्यवस्था को स्थिर रखेंगे: RBI बुलेटिन
items.summary_hi: RBI बुलेटिन के अनुसार, मजबूत मैक्रोइकनॉमिक फंडामेंटल्स और नीतिगत हस्तक्षेप भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था को वैश्विक मुद्रास्फीति और व्यापार तनाव के खिलाफ सहारा दे रहे हैं। भू-राजनीतिक तनाव से कीमतें बढ़ीं और आपूर्ति श्रृंखला की समस्याएं हुईं, लेकिन RBI के कदमों ने रुपये को स्थिर किया। विदेशी प्रत्यक्ष निवेश अमेरिका और सिंगापुर जैसे प्रमुख स्रोतों से मजबूत बना हुआ है।

items.text: EAAA India Alternatives has successfully raised approximately Rs 360 crore from anchor investors prior to its IPO. This IPO is set to open for public subscription on October 26. items.title: India's 10-year bond falls for 10th week in record slump
items.text: Indian government bonds have experienced their worst decline in thirty years, falling consecutively for ten weeks. Rising crude oil prices and a hawkish central bank stance have impacted the market negatively. The benchmark repo rate was recently raised to 5.5%, with further increases expected. The 2036 bond yield rose to 7.4740%, indicating a broader trend of increasing yields. These developments may significantly affect India's import bill and inflation outlook.
items.summary: Indian government bonds have fallen for a tenth consecutive week, marking the worst decline in thirty years. Rising crude oil prices and a hawkish central bank stance, including a repo rate hike to 5.5%, have driven yields higher. The 2036 bond yield reached 7.4740%, which may affect India's import bill and inflation.

items.title: India's forex reserves decline $5 billion to $721 billion: RBI data
items.text: India's forex reserves dropped by USD 5.011 billion to USD 721.016 billion during the week ended October 16, the Reserve Bank of India said on Friday. In the previous reporting week, the kitty declined by USD 8.578 billion to USD 726.027 billion. The reserves touched an all-time high of USD 785.706 billion for the week ended September 4, driven by heavy greenback inflow as part of a special concessional swap for deposits from the diaspora through which banks raised a record nearly USD 133 billion but have been on a declining trend ever since. items.summary: India's forex reserves declined by USD 5.011 billion to USD 721.016 billion for the week ended October 16, according to RBI data. The previous week saw a drop of USD 8.578 billion. Reserves had peaked at USD 785.706 billion in early September before starting a declining trend.

items.title: Govt sets rules for ₹84,084 cr offshore oil hunt, to share drilling risks
items.text: The government will share the cost of high-risk deepwater oil and gas exploration with energy companies under the Rs 84,084-crore Samudra Manthan scheme, offering to pay part of the cost of risky exploration wells, fund seismic mapping of offshore basins and help build shared production facilities. The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas issued operational guidelines for the Samudra Manthan programme, which aims to improve the economics of exploring India's deepwater and ultra-deepwater basins, where high drilling costs and uncertain geological prospects have constrained investment. The sche
items.summary: The government has issued operational guidelines for the Samudra Manthan scheme worth ₹84,084 crore. It will share the cost of high-risk deepwater oil and gas exploration with energy companies. The scheme aims to improve the economics of exploring India's deepwater and ultra-deepwater basins.

items.title: India’s labour survey to soon include platform workers and unpaid household work
items.text: India will update its Periodic Labour Force Survey starting January 2027 to enhance data collection. The modified sampling design aims to improve the identification of digital platform workers and unpaid household activities. Additionally, the updated sampling frame will reflect changes in urbanization and administrative boundaries. New questions will capture information on unpaid caregiving and volunteer work. Stakeholders are invited to provide feedback before the new sampling period begins.
items.summary: India will update its Periodic Labour Force Survey from January 2027 to include platform workers and unpaid household work. The new design will better capture digital platform workers, unpaid caregiving, and volunteer work. Stakeholders can give feedback before the new sampling period starts.

items.title: Shree Cement rebounds, gains over 5% from day's low post Q2 results
items.text: Shree Cement on Friday reported a 15.2% YoY drop in Q2 consolidated net profit at ₹263 crore, while its revenue from operations grew by 23.9% YoY to ₹5,897 crore.
items.summary: Shree Cement's Q2 consolidated net profit fell 15.2% year-on-year to ₹263 crore. However, its revenue from operations grew 23.9% year-on-year to ₹5,897 crore. The stock rebounded over 5% from its day's low after the results.
items.title_hi: Shree Cement Q2 नतीजों के बाद दिन के निचले स्तर से 5% से ज्यादा उछला
items.summary_hi: Shree Cement का Q2 समेकित शुद्ध मुनाफा 15.2% YoY गिरकर ₹263 करोड़ रहा। लेकिन परिचालन राजस्व 23.9% YoY बढ़कर ₹5,897 करोड़ हो गया। नतीजों के बाद शेयर दिन के निचले स्तर से 5% से ज्यादा उछला।

items.title: Raihan Vadra row deals another blow to India's global image as freedom-loving democracy: Tharoor
items.text: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor criticised the removal of photographs from Raihan Vadra’s exhibition at Bikaner House, calling it censorship that could damage India’s global reputation as a freedom-loving democracy. The controversy has drawn reactions from Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and the venue’s administration, which cited its exhibition policy for seeking the removal.
items.summary: Shashi Tharoor said the removal of photos from Raihan Vadra's exhibition at Bikaner House is censorship that harms India's image as a freedom-loving democracy. Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and the venue administration reacted, with the venue citing its exhibition policy.
items.title_hi: रायहान वाड्रा विवाद ने भारत की स्वतंत्रता-प्रेमी लोकतंत्र की वैश्विक छवि को एक और झटका दिया: थरूर
items.summary_hi: शशि थरूर ने बीकानेर हाउस में रायहान वाड्रा की प्रदर्शनी से तस्वीरें हटाने को सेंसरशिप बताया जो भारत की छवि खराब कर सकती है। प्रियंका गांधी वाड्रा और आयोजन स्थल के प्रशासन ने प्रतिक्रिया दी, प्रशासन ने अपनी प्रदर्शनी नीति का हवाला दिया।

items.title: Adani Total Gas hikes CNG prices by ₹4.45/kg amid rising procurement costs
items.text: Adani Total Gas Ltd, a city gas distributor supplying CNG and piped natural gas across cities in states, including Gujarat and Uttar Pradesh, has raised Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) prices by Rs 4.45 per kg, citing higher procurement costs driven by surging international Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) prices, reduced domestic gas availability and upstream supply curtailments. CNG at ATGL outlets in Ahmedabad now costs Rs 98.47 per kg, while it is priced at Rs 102.60 per kg in Faridabad, Haryana and Rs 100 per kg in Jalandhar, according to information on the company website. The revision comes as
items.summary: Adani Total Gas has raised CNG prices by ₹4.45 per kg due to higher procurement costs from surging international LNG prices and reduced domestic gas availability. CNG now costs ₹98.47 per kg in Ahmedabad, ₹102.60 per kg in Faridabad, and ₹100 per kg in Jalandhar.
items.title_hi: अडाणी टोटल गैस ने बढ़ती खरीद लागत के कारण CNG की कीमत ₹4.45/किग्रा बढ़ाई
items.summary_hi: अडाणी टोटल गैस ने CNG की कीमत ₹4.45 प्रति किलोग्राम बढ़ा दी है क्योंकि अंतरराष्ट्रीय LNG कीमतें बढ़ने और घरेलू गैस की उपलब्धता घटने से खरीद लागत बढ़ गई है। अब अहमदाबाद में CNG ₹98.47 प्रति किलोग्राम, फरीदाबाद में ₹102.60 प्रति किलोग्राम और जालंधर में ₹100 प्रति किलोग्राम है।

items.title: Akhilesh Yadav alleges booth-capturing by BJP during UP MLC polls in Fatehpur; slams EC
items.text: Akhilesh Yadav claimed that BJP workers tried to capture a polling booth in Fatehpur during the elections. He criticized the Election Commission for inaction and called for FIRs against involved officials. Polling for Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council seats began in the morning and runs until 4 pm. Voter turnout was low, with varying percentages across different constituencies. The elections hold significance ahead of the upcoming Uttar Pradesh Assembly polls.
items.summary: Akhilesh Yadav claimed BJP workers attempted to capture a polling booth in Fatehpur during UP MLC polls. He criticized the Election Commission for inaction and demanded FIRs against involved officials. Polling ran until 4 pm with low voter turnout across constituencies.
items.title_hi: अखिलेश यादव का आरोप: फतेहपुर में UP MLC चुनाव के दौरान BJP ने बूथ कैप्चरिंग की; EC की आलोचना
items.summary_hi: अखिलेश यादव ने दावा किया कि UP MLC चुनाव में फतेहपुर में BJP कार्यकर्ताओं ने बूथ कैप्चर करने की कोशिश की। उन्होंने चुनाव आयोग की निष्क्रियता की आलोचना की और शामिल अधिकारियों पर FIR की मांग की। मतदान शाम 4 बजे तक चला, कम मतदान प्रतिशत रहा।

items.title: Mozambique eyes India partnership to boost agro-processing, expand rice trade across Southern Africa
items.text: Mozambique is set to elevate its agricultural collaboration with India, tapping into mutual strengths in agro-processing. Secretary Antonio Do Rosario Grispos emphasized that India's rice imports are crucial for ensuring food security in Mozambique. This partnership aims to enhance trade routes via Mozambique's ports, fostering regional commerce and agricultural growth while strengthening historical ties with India as a strategic ally.
items.summary: Mozambique wants to strengthen agricultural ties with India for agro-processing and rice trade across Southern Africa. The partnership aims to use Mozambique's ports to boost regional commerce and food security.
items.title_hi: मोज़ाम्बिक भारत के साथ साझेदारी चाहता है ताकि कृषि-प्रसंस्करण बढ़े और दक्षिण अफ्रीका में चावल व्यापार का विस्तार हो
items.summary_hi: मोज़ाम्बिक कृषि-प्रसंस्करण और चावल व्यापार के लिए भारत के साथ कृषि सहयोग बढ़ाना चाहता है। यह साझेदारी मोज़ाम्बिक के बंदरगाहों के माध्यम से क्षेत्रीय वाणिज्य और खाद्य सुरक्षा को बढ़ावा देने का लक्ष्य रखती है।

items.title: SIR protest march heads towards ECI headquarters amid tight security in central Delhi
items.text: A march began in central Delhi to protest against the alleged deletion of voters from electoral rolls. Participants included members of various organizations, including Krantikari Yuva Sangathan and Students' Federation of India. Security was heightened near Bangla Sahib Gurudwara as the march approached the Election Commission of India headquarters. Traffic diversions were implemented in central Delhi to manage congestion due to the protest.
items.summary: A protest march started in central Delhi against the alleged deletion of voters from electoral rolls. Participants from groups like Krantikari Yuva Sangathan and Students' Federation of India marched toward the Election Commission of India headquarters. Security was tightened near Bangla Sahib Gurudwara and traffic diversions were put in place.
items.title_hi: SIR विरोध मार्च ECI मुख्यालय की ओर बढ़ा, केंद्रीय दिल्ली में कड़ी सुरक्षा
items.summary_hi: केंद्रीय दिल्ली में मतदाता सूची से नाम हटाने के आरोप के विरोध में मार्च शुरू हुआ। क्रांतिकारी युवा संगठन और स्टूडेंट्स फेडरेशन ऑफ इंडिया के सदस्यों ने ECI मुख्यालय की ओर मार्च किया। बांग्ला साहिब गुरुद्वारे के पास सुरक्षा बढ़ाई गई और यातायात परिवर्तित किया गया।

items.title: India must shift from rice volume to value, says Food Processing Minister Chirag Paswan
items.text: India has progressed in rice production and is now focusing on value addition and food processing. Food Processing Industries Minister Chirag Paswan outlined the need for improved quality and sustainability in the rice value chain. The government aims to enhance rice exports while promoting innovation in processing technologies. Strengthening agricultural links to industry is essential for achieving rural prosperity and increasing farmer incomes.
items.summary: Food Processing Minister Chirag Paswan says India must shift from rice volume to value addition. The government aims to enhance rice exports and promote innovation in processing technologies. Strengthening agricultural links to industry is seen as essential for rural prosperity and higher farmer incomes.
items.title_hi: भारत को चावल की मात्रा से मूल्य की ओर जाना चाहिए: खाद्य प्रसंस्करण मंत्री चिराग पासवान
items.summary_hi: खाद्य प्रसंस्करण मंत्री चिराग पासवान कहते हैं कि भारत को चावल की मात्रा से मूल्य संवर्धन की ओर जाना चाहिए। सरकार चावल निर्यात बढ़ाने और प्रसंस्करण प्रौद्योगिकियों में नवाचार को बढ़ावा देना चाहती है। कृषि को उद्योग से जोड़ना ग्रामीण समृद्धि और किसानों की आय बढ़ाने के लिए आवश्यक माना जाता है।

items.title: India’s Gen Z: In world's largest democracy, an electoral wildcard
items.text: India’s Gen Z population is sizeable, but its electoral influence will depend on voter eligibility, registration, turnout and constituency-level preferences. Experts explain why young Indians may not vote as a unified bloc, what Tamil Nadu’s 2026 election reveals about youth mobilisation, and why predicting their impact in 2029 remains difficult.
items.summary: India's Gen Z population is large but its electoral impact depends on eligibility, registration, turnout and local preferences. Experts say young Indians may not vote as a unified bloc. Tamil Nadu's 2026 election shows some youth mobilisation, but predicting 2029 impact is difficult.

items.text: Chennai Petroleum reported a PAT of ₹2,271 crore in Q2FY27, as against a PAT of ₹732 crore during the same quarter last year. This translates into a gain of 210 per cent on a Y-o-Y basis.

items.summary_hi: चेन्नई पेट्रोलियम ने Q2FY27 में ₹2,271 करोड़ का PAT दर्ज किया, जो पिछले साल की समान तिमाही में ₹732 करोड़ था, जो सालाना आधार पर 210% की वृद्धि है। ₹25 के लाभांश ने कमजोर बाजार में स्टॉक को 5% ऊपर उठाया।

items.title: Oil India discovers natural gas in shallow Krishna-Godavari waters
items.text: State-owned Oil India Ltd. (OIL) on Friday said it has made a natural gas discovery in a shallow-water Krishna Godavari basin block that the firm had won in recent Discovered Small Field (DSF) bid rounds. The discovery was made in the previously unappraised Matsyapuri formation in the Krishna-Godavari Basin off India's east coast, recording a peak test flow of 200,000 Standard Cubic Metres Per Day (SCMD), the state-run explorer said in a statement. The discovery was made in the Godavari-1 appraisal well in the KG-DSF/GSKW/2018 shallow-water offshore block, where testing of a hydrocarbon-bearin
items.summary: Oil India Ltd discovered natural gas in the Krishna-Godavari basin offshore block. The discovery in the Matsyapuri formation recorded a peak test flow of 200,000 SCMD. This was found in the Godavari-1 appraisal well in a shallow-water block won in recent DSF bid rounds.

items.title: India’s private sector activity hits four-month high as inflation cools: HSBC Flash India PMI
items.text: India’s private sector activity hit a four-month high in October as manufacturing and services gathered pace, new orders increased and inflationary pressures eased. However, hiring growth slowed, with employment rising at its weakest pace so far this year, according to a flash survey by HSBC.
items.summary: India's private sector activity reached a four-month high in October as manufacturing and services expanded. New orders increased while inflationary pressures eased, though hiring growth slowed to its weakest pace this year.
items.title_hi: भारत की निजी क्षेत्र की गतिविधि चार महीने के उच्चतम स्तर पर पहुंची क्योंकि मुद्रास्फीति ठंडी पड़ी: HSBC फ्लैश इंडिया PMI

items.title: Brisk polling in eight Bihar MLC seats; 150 candidates in fray
items.text: Polling for eight Bihar Legislative Council seats witnessed a significant turnout during the initial hours. Saran Teachers' constituency recorded the highest turnout, while several constituencies faced intense competition. Voting began at 8 am and will conclude at 4 pm today. The event includes a combined electorate of over five lakh voters across numerous polling stations. Counting of votes is scheduled to take place on October 27.
items.summary: Polling for eight Bihar Legislative Council seats saw brisk turnout in the initial hours. Saran Teachers' constituency recorded the highest turnout. Over five lakh voters are eligible across numerous polling stations. Counting is scheduled for October 27.
items.title_hi: बिहार की आठ एमएलसी सीटों पर तेज मतदान; 150 उम्मीदवार मैदान में
items.summary_hi: बिहार विधान परिषद की आठ सीटों के लिए मतदान के शुरुआती घंटों में अच्छी उपस्थिति देखी गई। सारण शिक्षक निर्वाचन क्षेत्र में सबसे अधिक मतदान हुआ। पांच लाख से अधिक मतदाता अनेक मतदान केंद्रों पर मतदान करेंगे। मतगणना 27 अक्टूबर को होगी।

items.title: Sudhanshu Trivedi alleges Rahul Gandhi meets "questionable individuals" abroad, engages in anti-India propaganda after returning
items.text: Sudhanshu Trivedi took aim at Rahul Gandhi, alleging his foreign trips involve unsavory characters and undermine India's reputation. The BJP figure criticized Gandhi for compromising the stature of opposition leadership and pointed to recent Congress electoral defeats as a sign of faltering leadership. He referenced Barack Obama's book, questioning Gandhi's readiness for political challenges and raised alarms about the influence of foreign-funded groups on Indian democracy.
items.summary: BJP leader Sudhanshu Trivedi accused Rahul Gandhi of meeting questionable individuals during foreign trips and engaging in anti-India propaganda. He also referenced Barack Obama's book to question Gandhi's political readiness and raised concerns about foreign-funded groups influencing Indian democracy.
items.title_hi: सुधांशु त्रिवेदी का आरोप: राहुल गांधी विदेश में 'संदिग्ध लोगों' से मिलते हैं, लौटकर भारत विरोधी प्रचार करते हैं
items.summary_hi: भाजपा नेता सुधांशु त्रिवेदी ने राहुल गांधी पर विदेश यात्राओं में संदिग्ध लोगों से मिलने और भारत विरोधी प्रचार करने का आरोप लगाया। उन्होंने बराक ओबामा की किताब का हवाला देकर गांधी की राजनीतिक तैयारी पर सवाल उठाए और विदेशी वित्त पोषित समूहों के भारतीय लोकतंत्र पर प्रभाव को लेकर चिंता जताई।

items.title: Piyush Goyal discusses investment opportunities with Bayer, Fresenius
items.text: Piyush Goyal held meetings with Bayer and Fresenius executives to discuss investment opportunities in India's healthcare sector. During these discussions, Goyal explored Bayer's expansion plans and potential collaborations in healthcare. He also examined how Fresenius can leverage India's skilled workforce for the healthcare market. Additionally, Goyal engaged with Knauf Group regarding sustainable construction materials and manufacturing operations in India. These meetings highlight India's growing role in global healthcare and manufacturing.
items.summary: Piyush Goyal met with Bayer and Fresenius executives to discuss healthcare investment opportunities in India. He also discussed sustainable construction materials with Knauf Group. These meetings show India's growing importance in global healthcare and manufacturing.
items.title_hi: पीयूष गोयल ने बायर, फ्रेसेनियस के साथ निवेश अवसरों पर चर्चा की
items.summary_hi: पीयूष गोयल ने बायर और फ्रेसेनियस के अधिकारियों से मिलकर भारत में स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्र में निवेश पर बात की। उन्होंने नॉफ ग्रुप के साथ टिकाऊ निर्माण सामग्री पर भी चर्चा की। ये बैठकें वैश्विक स्वास्थ्य और विनिर्माण में भारत की बढ़ती भूमिका दिखाती हैं।

items.title: Taxing top 1% isn't enough to solve income inequality; how governments spend matters | Opinion
items.text: 'Justice is the first virtue of social institutions…laws and institutions no matter how efficient and well-arranged must be reformed or abolished if they are unjust...an injustice is tolerable only when it is necessary to avoid an even greater injustice.'
items.summary: An opinion piece argues that taxing the top 1% alone is insufficient to solve income inequality, emphasizing that how governments spend matters more. The article references principles of justice in social institutions.
items.title_hi: शीर्ष 1% पर कर लगाना आय असमानता हल करने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं; सरकारें कैसे खर्च करती हैं यह मायने रखता है | राय
items.summary_hi: एक राय लेख का तर्क है कि केवल शीर्ष 1% पर कर लगाना आय असमानता हल करने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है, यह जोर देते हुए कि सरकारें कैसे खर्च करती हैं यह अधिक मायने रखता है। लेख सामाजिक संस्थानों में न्याय के सिद्धांतों का संदर्भ देता है।

items.title: Public Authority Can Revisit Auction To Maximise Price Of Public Property Before Binding Contract Is Concluded: Supreme Court
items.text: "While dealing with matters relating to sale or lease of public property, the action of a public authority to recall or revisit the auction process would be justified if the decision is intended to maximise the price for the sale/lease of public property"
items.summary: The Supreme Court held that a public authority can revisit an auction to maximise the price of public property before a binding contract is concluded. The court said such action is justified if intended to maximise the sale or lease price.

items.title: India October business growth hits 4-month high; hiring stalls, PMI shows
items.text: India's business activity expanded at its fastest pace in four months through a strong services-led pickup. The Composite Purchasing Managers' Index rose to 56.7 in October, exceeding forecasts due to increased orders. Despite this growth, hiring remained stagnant as companies managed workloads with current staff. Price pressures eased, resulting in lower input-cost inflation across both sectors. Overall, business confidence improved but remained below the average for the year.
items.summary: India's business activity grew at its fastest pace in four months in October, driven by services. The Composite PMI rose to 56.7, beating forecasts. However, hiring stayed flat as firms used existing staff, while price pressures eased.
items.title_hi: भारत की अक्टूबर कारोबारी वृद्धि 4 महीने के उच्च स्तर पर; PMI के अनुसार भर्ती रुकी

items.title: Profitability No Ground To Stall Insolvency Process Under IBC: Supreme Court
items.summary: The Supreme Court held that profitability of a company is not a valid ground to stall the insolvency process under the IBC. The ruling clarifies that financial health does not override insolvency proceedings.

items.summary_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने कहा कि कंपनी की लाभप्रदता IBC के तहत दिवालिया प्रक्रिया रोकने का वैध आधार नहीं है। यह फैसला स्पष्ट करता है कि वित्तीय स्वास्थ्य दिवालिया कार्यवाही को ओवरराइड नहीं कर सकता।

Despite the drop, the trial results showed promising reductions in cancer recurrence when paired with Merck's Keytruda.

items.title: MPC minutes: Two more interest rate hikes on cards, maybe even a third
items.text: Market participants and economists now expect a 25-bps increase in the December and February reviews. A further 25-bps increase in April isn't ruled out if crude oil prices remain persistently above $100. One basis point is a hundredth of a percentage point. "After the minutes were released, we think the probability of a consecutive hike in December has increased. Our terminal rate forecast is now at 6% for this hiking cycle and we expect the cycle to be rather shallow," Barclays said in a note.
items.summary: MPC minutes suggest two more interest rate hikes are likely, with a third possible. Economists expect 25-bps increases in December and February reviews, and another in April if crude oil stays above $100.

items.summary_hi: केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने मतदान में गड़बड़ी के आरोपों पर राहुल गांधी की आलोचना की। शाह ने दावा किया कि गांधी घुसपैठियों के वोटों की रक्षा करते हैं। उन्होंने कहा कि NDA पंजाब जीतेगी और BJP लगातार चुनाव जीतती है।

items.title: Manoj Jarange releases Rs 500 crore audio clip; Shinde Sena seeks answers from BJP
items.text: While Patil has sought a probe into the matter, claiming the clip was made to defame him, Shiv Sena has demanded a probe to know the identity of the leaders involved and the action BJP would take against them.
items.summary: Manoj Jarange released an audio clip mentioning Rs 500 crore. Shiv Sena demands a probe into the leaders involved and action from BJP. Patil claims the clip was made to defame him and seeks investigation.
items.title_hi: मनोज जारंगे ने 500 करोड़ रुपये का ऑडियो क्लिप जारी किया; शिंदे सेना ने BJP से जवाब मांगा
items.summary_hi: मनोज जारंगे ने 500 करोड़ रुपये का उल्लेख करने वाला एक ऑडियो क्लिप जारी किया। शिवसेना ने शामिल नेताओं की जांच और BJP से कार्रवाई की मांग की है। पाटिल का दावा है कि क्लिप उन्हें बदनाम करने के लिए बनाया गया था और वे जांच चाहते हैं।

items.title: Centre flags land, green tape hurdles in infra projects
items.text: Delays in land acquisition and obtaining various environmental clearances have significantly impacted the progress of infrastructure projects. Although central agencies are improving approval times, states are still facing lengthy procedures for necessary permits. Utility shifting is also causing major disruptions, often taking longer than projected. The recent analysis reveals a considerable increase in costs due to pre-construction delays.
items.summary: The Centre has highlighted that land acquisition and environmental clearances are causing delays in infrastructure projects. While central agencies are speeding up approvals, states still face lengthy permit procedures. Utility shifting is also taking longer than expected, increasing costs.
items.title_hi: केंद्र ने इंफ्रा परियोजनाओं में भूमि, पर्यावरण मंजूरी की बाधाओं को चिह्नित किया
items.summary_hi: केंद्र ने कहा है कि भूमि अधिग्रहण और पर्यावरण मंजूरी से इंफ्रा परियोजनाओं में देरी हो रही है। केंद्रीय एजेंसियां मंजूरी तेज कर रही हैं, लेकिन राज्यों में लंबी प्रक्रियाएं जारी हैं। यूटिलिटी शिफ्टिंग भी अपेक्षा से अधिक समय ले रही है, जिससे लागत बढ़ रही है।

items.title: Punjab Hit As Over 3 Lakh Government Employees, Roadways Workers On Strike
items.text: The continuing strike by the Punjab Roadways, PUNBUS and PRTC Contract Workers' Union has affected bus services across the state. Negotiations have failed to produce a breakthrough.
items.summary: Over 3 lakh government employees and roadways workers in Punjab are on strike. Bus services across the state have been affected. Negotiations have failed to produce a breakthrough.
items.title_hi: पंजाब में 3 लाख से अधिक सरकारी कर्मचारी और रोडवेज कर्मचारी हड़ताल पर
items.summary_hi: पंजाब में 3 लाख से अधिक सरकारी कर्मचारी और रोडवेज कर्मचारी हड़ताल पर हैं। पूरे राज्य में बस सेवाएं प्रभावित हुई हैं। बातचीत से कोई समाधान नहीं निकला।

items.title: RBI asks banks, payment firms to forensically clear tech environments in case of a data breach
items.text: The RBI has asked financial entities to remove management and administrative interfaces from public internet access, enforce multi-factor authentication for administrative access, and restrict access to cloud and backend systems on a least-privilege basis. The measures include auditing source code, repositories, configuration files, client applications and cloud storage for exposed credentials, and immediately rotating and purging compromised credentials.
items.summary: The RBI has directed banks and payment firms to secure their technology environments after a data breach. They must remove admin interfaces from public internet, enforce multi-factor authentication, and restrict cloud and backend access. Entities must also audit code and credentials, and rotate compromised credentials immediately.
items.title_hi: आरबीआई ने बैंकों, भुगतान फर्मों को डेटा उल्लंघन की स्थिति में तकनीकी वातावरण को फोरेंसिक रूप से साफ करने को कहा
items.summary_hi: आरबीआई ने बैंकों और भुगतान फर्मों को डेटा उल्लंघन के बाद अपने तकनीकी वातावरण को सुरक्षित करने का निर्देश दिया है। उन्हें एडमिन इंटरफेस को पब्लिक इंटरनेट से हटाना होगा, मल्टी-फैक्टर ऑथेंटिकेशन लागू करना होगा, और क्लाउड व बैकएंड एक्सेस को प्रतिबंधित करना होगा। साथ ही कोड और क्रेडेंशियल्स की ऑडिट करनी होगी और समझौता किए गए क्रेडेंशियल्स को तुरंत बदलना होगा।

items.title: Yields plummet as fears about AI boom sustainability flare
items.text: USA-BONDS/ (UPDATE 2, GRAPHIC):TREASURI
items.summary: Yields plummeted as fears about AI boom sustainability flared up. The item appears to be a truncated bond market update.
items.title_hi: AI बूम की स्थिरता पर डर से यील्ड में गिरावट
items.summary_hi: AI बूम की स्थिरता पर डर बढ़ने से यील्ड में तेज गिरावट आई। यह आइटम बाजार अपडेट का छोटा रूप लगता है।

items.title: Treasuries see best day in over a year as AI selloff revives haven demand
items.text: US Treasury bonds surged as a sharp selloff in AI-linked stocks revived demand for safe-haven assets. Treasury yields posted their biggest declines in more than a year, despite Brent crude rising above $112 a barrel. Investors also scaled back expectations for a December Fed rate hike amid growing concerns over AI spending and US growth.
items.summary: US Treasury bonds surged as a selloff in AI-linked stocks increased demand for safe-haven assets. Treasury yields had their biggest declines in over a year, even as Brent crude rose above $112 a barrel. Investors reduced expectations for a December Fed rate hike due to concerns about AI spending and US growth.
items.title_hi: ट्रेजरी बॉन्ड्स को एक साल से अधिक समय में सबसे अच्छा दिन मिला क्योंकि AI बिकवाली ने सुरक्षित संपत्ति की मांग बढ़ाई
items.summary_hi: अमेरिकी ट्रेजरी बॉन्ड्स में तेजी आई क्योंकि AI से जुड़े शेयरों की बिकवाली से सुरक्षित संपत्तियों की मांग बढ़ी। ट्रेजरी यील्ड में एक साल से अधिक की सबसे बड़ी गिरावट आई, भले ही ब्रेंट क्रूड $112 प्रति बैरल से ऊपर चला गया। निवेशकों ने AI खर्च और अमेरिकी वृद्धि की चिंताओं के कारण दिसंबर में फेड दर वृद्धि की उम्मीदें कम कर दीं।

items.title: Gurugram Plunges Into Darkness As Electricity Workers Go On Strike
items.text: The employees of DHBVN are striking against the government's decision to privatise the power distribution system in Gurugram and Nuh.
items.summary: Gurugram plunged into darkness as electricity workers went on strike. Employees of DHBVN are striking against the government's decision to privatise power distribution in Gurugram and Nuh.
items.title_hi: गुरुग्राम में अंधेरा छाया, बिजली कर्मचारियों की हड़ताल
items.summary_hi: गुरुग्राम में बिजली कर्मचारियों की हड़ताल से अंधेरा छा गया। DHBVN के कर्मचारी गुरुग्राम और नूंह में बिजली वितरण के निजीकरण के सरकार के फैसले के खिलाफ हड़ताल पर हैं।

items.title: Traders’ Cost of Hedging Against Big Treasuries Rally Is Soaring
items.text: The cost of options hedges against more gains in Treasuries surged to its highest level since March on Thursday, as investors sought the safety of US government bonds following a spike in oil prices and a deepening fiscal crisis in France.
items.summary: The cost of hedging against a rally in US Treasuries has surged to its highest level since March. This increase came as investors bought US government bonds for safety after oil prices spiked and a fiscal crisis deepened in France.
items.title_hi: ट्रेडर्स की ट्रेजरी रैली के खिलाफ हेजिंग की लागत बढ़ रही है
items.summary_hi: अमेरिकी ट्रेजरी में तेजी के खिलाफ हेजिंग की लागत मार्च के बाद से अपने उच्चतम स्तर पर पहुंच गई है। तेल की कीमतों में उछाल और फ्रांस में गहराते वित्तीय संकट के बाद निवेशकों ने सुरक्षा के लिए अमेरिकी सरकारी बॉन्ड खरीदे, जिससे यह वृद्धि हुई।

items.title: BJP vs TDP: Dispute over 21 villages — claimed by both Odisha and Andhra Pradesh; BJD, Congress join battle
items.text: While Odisha claims that these villages are part of Pottangi block in Odisha’s Koraput district, Andhra Pradesh asserts that these villages fall under Salur block of Parvathipuram Manyam district. Former Odisha CM Naveen Patnaik, former Union minister Dharmendra Pradhan and other Odisha leaders have objected to the Andhra government’s notification.
items.summary: BJP and TDP are in a dispute over 21 villages claimed by both Odisha and Andhra Pradesh. Odisha says the villages are in Pottangi block of Koraput district. Andhra Pradesh says they fall under Salur block of Parvathipuram Manyam district. BJD and Congress have joined the battle.
items.title_hi: बीजेपी बनाम टीडीपी: 21 गांवों पर विवाद — ओडिशा और आंध्र प्रदेश दोनों का दावा; बीजेडी, कांग्रेस भी शामिल
items.summary_hi: बीजेपी और टीडीपी में 21 गांवों पर विवाद है, जिन पर ओडिशा और आंध्र प्रदेश दोनों दावा करते हैं। ओडिशा का कहना है कि ये गांव कोरापुट जिले के पोट्टांगी ब्लॉक में हैं। आंध्र प्रदेश का दावा है कि ये पार्वतीपुरम मान्यम जिले के सालूर ब्लॉक में आते हैं। बीजेडी और कांग्रेस भी इस लड़ाई में शामिल हो गए हैं।

items.title: Yen jumps as oil, AI and France worries rattle markets
items.text: GLOBAL-FOREX:Yen jumps as oil, AI and France worries rattle markets
items.summary: The yen jumped as concerns over oil, AI, and France rattled markets.
items.title_hi: तेल, AI और फ्रांस की चिंताओं से बाजार हिलने पर येन उछला
items.summary_hi: तेल, AI और फ्रांस की चिंताओं से बाजार हिलने पर येन उछला।

items.title: Pregnant Teen Gang-Raped In Rajasthan, Baby Dies Soon After Delivery
items.text: The incident occurred in the Kolwa police station area, where the 16-year-old girl was found to be pregnant and subsequently delivered a baby who did not survive, according to the police.
items.summary: A 16-year-old pregnant girl was gang-raped in the Kolwa police station area of Rajasthan. She delivered a baby that died soon after, according to police.
items.title_hi: राजस्थान में गर्भवती किशोरी से सामूहिक बलात्कार, प्रसव के बाद बच्चे की मौत
items.summary_hi: राजस्थान के कोलवा थाना क्षेत्र में 16 वर्षीय गर्भवती किशोरी से सामूहिक बलात्कार हुआ। प्रसव के बाद बच्चे की मृत्यु हो गई, पुलिस के अनुसार।

items.title: RSS Holds Mega Outreach Event In Srinagar, Hosts Divergent Voices
items.text: The Akhil Bharatiya Samparkh Pramukh (All-India Public Outreach Head) of RSS, Ram Lal, attended the conference as chief guest
items.summary: The RSS held a large outreach event in Srinagar. The organisation's All-India Public Outreach Head Ram Lal attended as chief guest.
items.title_hi: आरएसएस ने श्रीनगर में बड़ा आउटरीच कार्यक्रम आयोजित किया, विभिन्न विचारों को मंच दिया
items.summary_hi: आरएसएस ने श्रीनगर में एक बड़ा आउटरीच कार्यक्रम आयोजित किया। संगठन के अखिल भारतीय संपर्क प्रमुख राम लाल मुख्य अतिथि के रूप में शामिल हुए।

items.title: Chana sowing holds key to pulses inflation
items.text: Chana, India's most consumed pulse, which is central to making everything from salty snacks to nutritious meals, needs adequate soil moisture and cool weather for a good crop. Sowing has started in some regions, but the progress is slow. State advisories to conserve water and shift to less water-intensive crops have added to concerns over winter sowing.
items.summary: Chana (chickpea) sowing is crucial for pulses inflation. Sowing has begun but is slow due to need for moisture and cool weather. State water conservation advisories and crop shift recommendations add to winter sowing concerns.
items.title_hi: चना बुआई दालों की महंगाई के लिए अहम
items.summary_hi: चना (चना दाल) की बुआई दालों की महंगाई के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है। बुआई शुरू हो गई है लेकिन धीमी है क्योंकि नमी और ठंडे मौसम की जरूरत है। राज्यों की पानी बचाने और कम पानी वाली फसलें उगाने की सलाह से सर्दी की बुआई की चिंता बढ़ गई है।

items.title: India-Germany trade can surge 10-fold, says Piyush Goyal
items.text: India-Germany bilateral trade is expected to increase significantly, with aims of reaching 310 billion from 31 billion. Both countries are focused on co-creating and leveraging their complementary strengths for economic growth. The India-EU free trade agreement is anticipated to be signed soon and will facilitate mutual benefits. Minister Piyush Goyal emphasized the importance of trust and cooperation between the nations.
items.summary: India-Germany trade could grow tenfold, targeting 310 billion from the current 31 billion. Both nations aim to leverage complementary strengths, and an India-EU free trade agreement is expected soon. Minister Piyush Goyal stressed the importance of trust and cooperation.
items.title_hi: भारत-जर्मनी व्यापार 10 गुना बढ़ सकता है: पीयूष गोयल
items.summary_hi: भारत-जर्मनी व्यापार दस गुना बढ़ सकता है, लक्ष्य 310 अरब से मौजूदा 31 अरब तक। दोनों देश अपनी पूरक ताकतों का लाभ उठाना चाहते हैं, और भारत-ईयू मुक्त व्यापार समझौता जल्द होने की उम्मीद है। मंत्री पीयूष गोयल ने विश्वास और सहयोग पर जोर दिया।

items.title: Barclays to cut 5,000 jobs in AI-led cost drive as Q3 profit rises 12%
items.text: Barclays plans to cut around 5,000 jobs, or 5% of its workforce, this year as it uses AI to reduce costs, even as third-quarter profit rose 12% to £2.3 billion.
items.summary: Barclays plans to cut around 5,000 jobs, which is 5% of its workforce, as it uses AI to reduce costs. This comes even as third-quarter profit rose 12% to £2.3 billion.
items.title_hi: बार्कलेज AI-चालित कॉस्ट ड्राइव में 5,000 नौकरियां काटेगा क्योंकि Q3 प्रॉफिट 12% बढ़ा
items.summary_hi: बार्कलेज लगभग 5,000 नौकरियां काटने की योजना बना रहा है, जो उसके वर्कफोर्स का 5% है, क्योंकि यह AI का उपयोग करके कॉस्ट कम कर रहा है। यह तब भी है जब थर्ड-क्वार्टर प्रॉफिट 12% बढ़कर £2.3 बिलियन हो गया।

items.title: GST return forms likely to be tweaked to curb mismatches
items.text: The government is looking to revamp GST return forms to minimise discrepancies between reported sales and tax payments. Draft forms will be available for public feedback starting November 1 and the changes take effect on April 1, 2027.
items.summary: The government plans to revamp GST return forms to reduce mismatches between reported sales and tax payments. Draft forms will be open for public feedback from November 1, with changes taking effect on April 1, 2027.
items.title_hi: GST रिटर्न फॉर्म में बदलाव की संभावना ताकि गड़बड़ियाँ रोकी जा सकें
items.summary_hi: सरकार GST रिटर्न फॉर्म को नया रूप देने की योजना बना रही है ताकि बिक्री और टैक्स भुगतान में अंतर कम हो। ड्राफ्ट फॉर्म 1 नवंबर से सार्वजनिक सुझाव के लिए उपलब्ध होंगे और बदलाव 1 अप्रैल 2027 से लागू होंगे।

items.title: Following Supreme Court directions, Andhra Pradesh urban polls paused
items.text: Even as SEC paused the process, YSRCP alleged that the ruling TDP cadres continued to attack and intimidate its candidates for the second consecutive day. The Opposition party released videos of several places and alleged that the modus operandi had been to not allow senior YSRCP leaders to accompany candidates to nomination centres and then snatch the nomination papers to prevent them from filing.
items.summary: The Supreme Court directed Andhra Pradesh urban polls to be paused. The State Election Commission halted the process. YSRCP alleges TDP cadres attacked and intimidated candidates for a second day and snatched nomination papers.
items.title_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट के निर्देशों के बाद, आंध्र प्रदेश शहरी चुनाव रोके गए
items.summary_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने आंध्र प्रदेश के शहरी चुनाव रोकने का निर्देश दिया। राज्य चुनाव आयोग ने प्रक्रिया रोक दी। YSRCP का आरोप है कि TDP कार्यकर्ताओं ने लगातार दूसरे दिन उम्मीदवारों पर हमला किया और नामांकन पत्र छीन लिए।

items.title: Berlin Global Dialogue: EU inviting disaster through carbon tax, says Piyush Goyal
items.text: Piyush Goyal expressed concerns over the EU's carbon tax and numerous regulations impacting their steel industry. He warned that these measures could lead to increased costs and decreased competitiveness for EU businesses. Goyal highlighted that the high import duties and standards could harm the economy and raise the cost of living. He mentioned the reciprocal nature of trade regulations in response to the EU's actions.
items.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal warned that the EU's carbon tax and regulations could hurt European steel competitiveness and raise costs. He said high import duties and standards may harm the economy and increase living costs, noting the reciprocal nature of trade rules.
items.title_hi: बर्लिन ग्लोबल डायलॉग: EU कार्बन टैक्स से बुला रहा है आपदा, बोले पीयूष गोयल
items.summary_hi: वाणिज्य मंत्री पीयूष गोयल ने चेताया कि EU के कार्बन टैक्स और नियम यूरोपीय इस्पात उद्योग की प्रतिस्पर्धा घटा सकते हैं और लागत बढ़ा सकते हैं। उन्होंने कहा कि ऊंचे आयात शुल्क और मानक अर्थव्यवस्था को नुकसान पहुंचा सकते हैं और जीवनयापन महंगा कर सकते हैं।

items.title: Meta share price: Stock slumps 7.5% despite upbeat Q3 results; why is Facebook parent falling?
items.text: Meta shares fell 7.5% after the company raised its capital-spending outlook to as much as $145 billion to advance its AI strategy, despite quarterly revenue exceeding expectations.

items.text: Yes Bank has announced potential non-payment of coupons on additional tier-1 bonds this fiscal year following a Supreme Court decision that annulled the previous write-off of these bonds. items.title: Tesla shares slip after capex cut raises doubts over Musk's AI and robotics push
items.text: Tesla's shares dipped by 2% after it reduced its capital spending forecast for 2026, now predicting $20 billion instead of the previous $25 billion. This move has raised eyebrows among investors, especially with Tesla's stock already down 14% this year. Yet, it still boasts a higher valuation than many traditional automakers. Meanwhile, potential merger talks with SpaceX hint at regulatory hurdles that might prolong uncertainty for investors.
items.summary: Tesla shares fell 2% after the company cut its 2026 capital spending forecast from $25 billion to $20 billion. The stock is already down 14% this year. Potential merger talks with SpaceX may face regulatory hurdles.

items.title: Kolkata home registrations dip 12 per cent in Jan-Sep; larger flats gain share
items.text: In the first three quarters of 2026, home registrations in the Kolkata Metropolitan Area fell to 41,309, highlighting a year-on-year decline. Yet, there was an observable trend towards mid-sized and larger apartments. Specifically, September recorded 4,845 registrations, down from the previous year, with North Kolkata dominating 36% of the total shares. This data reveals a growing preference for spacious and practical living spaces among buyers.
items.summary: Home registrations in the Kolkata Metropolitan Area fell 12% year-on-year in the first three quarters of 2026, totalling 41,309. However, larger apartments gained market share, with North Kolkata accounting for 36% of registrations.

items.title: Hatsun Agro Product Q2 Results: Profit rises 5.6% on strong sales
items.text: Hatsun Agro Product reported a notable growth in net profit for the September quarter, reaching Rs 115.69 crore, up from Rs 109.54 crore from last year. Total income also surged to Rs 2,902.49 crore, showcasing strong sales amidst industry hurdles. The company emphasizes enhancing direct consumer relationships and expanding its market footprint in Maharashtra and Odisha, while continuing to invest in its procurement, processing, and distribution systems.
items.summary: Hatsun Agro Product's net profit rose 5.6% to ₹115.69 crore in the September quarter from ₹109.54 crore a year earlier. Total income surged to ₹2,902.49 crore, driven by strong sales, as the company expands in Maharashtra and Odisha.

items.text: US stocks opened lower on Thursday as renewed concerns over the outlook for artificial intelligence weighed on growth stocks. Tesla and Meta earnings failed to ease AI-related jitters, while rising oil prices added to market pressure. The Nasdaq fell 1.48%, while the S&P 500 and Dow also declined at the open.
