items.title_hi: ट्रेज़रीज़ गिरीं क्योंकि टेक शेयरों में बढ़त आई और हेवन डिमांड कम हो गई
items.summary_hi: ट्रेज़रीज़ इसलिए गिरीं क्योंकि अमेरिकी टेक शेयरों में rebound आया। इस rebound ने हेवन डिमांड अमेरिकी सरकारी ऋण के लिए कम कर दी।

items.title: Allahabad High Court stays conviction of murder convict who wishes to contest 2027 U.P. polls
items.text: The court granted bail to the appellant, noting that he was a political figure and an active Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) worker before his conviction
items.summary: The Allahabad High Court has stayed the conviction of a murder convict who wants to contest the 2027 Uttar Pradesh polls. The court granted bail to the appellant, noting he was a political figure and an active BJP worker before his conviction.
items.title_hi: अल्लाहाबाद हाईकोर्ट ने हत्या के दोषी की सजा पर रोक लगाई, जो 2027 यूपी चुनाव लड़ना चाहता है
items.summary_hi: अल्लाहाबाद हाईकोर्ट ने एक हत्या के दोषी की सजा पर रोक लगा दी है जो 2027 उत्तर प्रदेश चुनाव लड़ना चाहता है। कोर्ट ने अपीलेंट को जमानत देते हुए कहा कि वह एक राजनीतिक ह activo और बीजेपी कार्यकर्ता था जब उसकी सजा हुई।

items.title: Trump Open to Putin, Xi Summit But Would Focus on Nuclear Arms
items.text: President Donald Trump said he would be willing to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping but indicated his focus would be on denuclearization efforts rather than ending the war in Ukraine.
items.summary: President Donald Trump said he would be open to meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping. He indicated his focus would be on denuclearization rather than ending the war in Ukraine.
items.title_hi: ट्रंप पुतिन और शी के साथ बैठक के लिए खुले हैं लेकिन परमाणु हथियारों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करेंगे
items.summary_hi: अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप ने कहा कि वे रूसी राष्ट्रपति व्लादिमीर पुतिन और चीनी राष्ट्रपति शी जिनपिंग से मिलने के लिए खुले हैं. उन्होंने बताया कि उनका ध्यान परमाणु निरस्त्रीकरण पर होगा, यूक्रेन युद्ध को समाप्त करने के बजाय।

items.title: TSX pulls back from three-week high as financials, metal miners fall
items.text: CANADA-STOCKS/ (UPDATE 2):CANADA STOCKS-TSX pulls back from three-week high as financials, metal miners fall
items.summary: TSX retreated from its three-week high because financial and metal mining stocks declined. The drop was driven by losses in the financial sector and metal miners.
items.title_hi: TSX तीन सप्ताह के उच्च स्तर से पीछे हट गया क्योंकि वित्तीय और धातु खनन शेयर गिरे
items.summary_hi: TSX अपने तीन सप्ताह के उच्च स्तर से पीछे हट गया। इस गिरावट का कारण वित्तीय और धातु खनन क्षेत्रों में गिरावट थी।

items.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq leads Wall Street gains as chip, AI stocks rebound
items.text: US stocks ended mixed on Monday, with the Nasdaq leading gains as chip and AI-linked stocks bounced back after last week’s sharp selloff. Investors also tracked corporate earnings and fresh stock-specific moves, while concerns over AI spending and financing remained in focus.
items.summary: US stocks ended mixed on Monday. The Nasdaq led gains as chip and AI-linked stocks bounced back after a sharp selloff the previous week. Investors watched corporate earnings and stock-specific moves while concerns about AI spending and financing persisted.
items.title_hi: आज के US शेयरों में Nasdaq ने Wall Street के लाभ में नेतृत्व किया, चिप और AI शेयरों में rebound के कारण
items.summary_hi: US शेयरों में सोमवार को मिला-जुला अंत हुआ। Nasdaq ने लाभ बढ़ाया, क्योंकि चिप और AI जुड़े शेयरों में पिछले सप्ताह की तेज़ बिकवाली के बाद rebound हुआ। निवेशकों ने कॉर्पोरेट कमाई और स्टॉक-विशिष्ट कदमों पर नजर रखी, जबकि AI खर्च और वित्तपोषण के बारे में चिंता बनी रही।

items.title: SBI data breach claim: Hackers allegedly access 3.75 lakh accounts
items.text: "The threat actor describes this as the first disclosure of the dataset, Cyberpulse56 said, adding that the authenticity, origin and extent of the alleged exposure are inverified. If legitimate, the data could facilitate identity theft, financial fraud, targeted phishing and fraudulent loan applications, the group said.
items.summary: It is claimed that hackers accessed 3.75 lakh SBI accounts. The threat actor says this is the first disclosure of the dataset and that its authenticity, origin and extent are unverified. If the data is genuine, it could be used for identity theft, financial fraud, targeted phishing and fraudulent loan applications.
items.title_hi: SBI डेटा breach दावा: हैकर्स कथित रूप से 3.75 लाख खातों तक पहुँच बनाते हैं
items.summary_hi: यह दावा किया गया है कि हैकर्स ने 3.75 लाख SBI खातों तक पहुंच बनाई। धमकी देने वाले ने कहा कि यह डेटासेट का पहला खुलासा है और उसकी प्रामाणिकता, उत्पत्ति और विस्तार अप्रमाणित हैं। यदि डेटा genuine है, तो इसे पहचान चोरी, वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी, लक्षित फ़िशिंग और धोखाधड़ी वाले ऋण आवेदनों में उपयोग किया जा सकता है।

items.title: Jaishankar welcomes UAE’s Foreign Minister Al Nahyan in Mumbai
items.text: PM Al Nahyan, who is also the UAE's Foreign Minister, will hold wide-ranging talks with External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar on October 20
items.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar welcomed the UAE’s Foreign Minister, PM Al Nahyan, in Mumbai. PM Al Nahyan will hold wide-ranging talks with Jaishankar on October 20.
items.title_hi: जयशंकर ने मुंबई में UAE के विदेश मंत्री अल नाहयान का स्वागत किया
items.summary_hi: भारत के विदेश मंत्री एस. जयशंकर ने मुंबई में UAE के विदेश मंत्री पीएम अल नाहयान का स्वागत किया। पीएम अल नाहयान October 20 को जयशंकर के साथ व्यापक चर्चा करेंगे।

items.title: RBI injects Rs 1 lakh crore as liquidity tightens before festive season
items.text: On Monday, the RBI announced a Rs 1-lakh-crore variable rate repo (VRR) auction for the first time since late July after the weighted average call rate (WACR) at 5.67% on Monday, or 17 basis points higher than the repo rate of 5.50%. The central bank will conduct another VRR for Rs 50,000 crore on Wednesday.
items.summary: The RBI injected Rs 1 lakh crore through a variable rate repo auction as liquidity tightened before the festive season. The auction came after the weighted average call rate rose to 5.67%, which is 17 basis points above the repo rate of 5.50%. Another VRR of Rs 50,000 crore will be held on Wednesday.
items.title_hi: RBI ने त्योहारी मौसम से पहले liquidity की कसावट के कारण Rs 1 lakh crore डाला
items.summary_hi: RBI ने फेस्टिवल सीजन से पहले liquidity की कसावट के कारण variable rate repo auction के जरिए Rs 1 lakh crore डाला। इस नीलामी के बाद weighted average call rate 5.67% तक बढ़ गई, जो repo rate 5.50% से 17 basis points अधिक है। Another VRR של Rs 50,000 crore बुधवार को आयोजित किया जाएगा।

items.title: RBI injects Rs 1 lakh crore as liquidity tightens before festive season
items.text: On Monday, the RBI announced a Rs 1-lakh-crore variable rate repo (VRR) auction for the first time since late July after the weighted average call rate (WACR) at 5.67% on Monday, or 17 basis points higher than the repo rate of 5.50%. The central bank will conduct another VRR for Rs 50,000 crore on Wednesday.
items.summary: RBI announced a Rs 1 lakh crore variable rate repo auction on Monday. This was the first such auction since late July, after the weighted average call rate stood at 5.67%, which is 17 basis points above the repo rate of 5.50%. The central bank will hold another VRR of Rs 50,000 crore on Wednesday.
items.title_hi: RBI ने liquidity कसने के त्योहारी सीजन से पहले Rs 1 लाख करोड़ डाला
items.summary_hi: RBI ने सोमवार को Rs 1 लाख करोड़ का variable rate repo (VRR) नीलामी की घोषणा की। यह लंबे समय बाद जुलाई के बाद पहली ऐसी नीलामी थी, जब weighted average call rate (WACR) 5.67% पर था, जो repo दर 5.50% से 17 basis points अधिक था। केंद्रीय बैंक बुधवार को Rs 50,000 करोड़ की另一 VRR नीलामी करेगा।

items.title: Yes Bank's evaluating capital actions to back growth plans
items.text: "The manner and the timing of reinstatement of the bonds as well as payment of the coupon is also under assessment," Niranjan Banodkar, CFO, Yes Bank told analysts over a call after the earnings.
items.summary: Yes Bank is evaluating capital actions to support its growth plans. The bank is assessing how and when to reinstate its bonds and pay coupons, according to its CFO.
items.title_hi: Yes Bank अपनी वृद्धि योजनाओं का समर्थन करने के लिए पूंजी कार्रवाइयों का मूल्यांकन कर रहा है
items.summary_hi: Yes Bank अपनी वृद्धि योजनाओं का समर्थन करने के लिए पूंजी कार्रवाइयों का मूल्यांकन कर रहा है। बैंक अपने बॉन्ड्स को फिर से शुरू करने और कूपन भुगतान के तरीके और समय का मूल्यांकन कर रहा है, जैसा कि इसके CFO नीरजन बनोदकर ने कहा।

items.title: China curbs spur push for local manufacturing
items.text: India's government will consult stakeholders on measures to mitigate the impact of Chinese export constraints. China recently imposed new restrictions on heavy machinery, such as tunnel boring machines, set to take effect soon. Indian officials assert that there should be no significant slowdown in highway development despite these curbs. The domestic construction industry is becoming increasingly self-sufficient regarding general equipment needs.
items.summary: India's government will talk with stakeholders to reduce the impact of Chinese export limits. China has added new rules on heavy machinery such as tunnel boring machines, which will start soon. Officials say highway work will not slow down much, and local builders are relying more on their own equipment.
items.title_hi: चीन के प्रतिबंध स्थानीय निर्माण को बढ़ावा दे रहे हैं
items.summary_hi: भारत सरकार चीनी निर्यात सीमाओं के प्रभाव को कम करने के लिए हितधारकों से परामर्श करेगी। चीन ने भारी मशीनरी, जैसे टनल बोरिंग मशीन पर नए प्रतिबंध लगाए हैं, जो जल्द ही प्रभावी होंगे। अधिकारी कहते हैं कि राजमार्ग विकास पर महत्वपूर्ण धीमी गति नहीं आएगी, और घरेलू निर्माण उद्योग सामान्य उपकरणों की आवश्यकता के लिए अधिक आत्मनिर्भर हो रहा है।

items.title: Finance Ministry to run financial inclusion campaign
items.text: The finance ministry is launching a campaign to saturate financial schemes across various local bodies. This initiative will reach 2.70 lakh gram panchayats and urban local bodies throughout India. Banks are expected to organize camps for enrolments and Aadhaar seeding for key schemes. The campaign will also involve updating nominations in savings accounts and providing other financial facilities.
items.summary: The finance ministry is launching a campaign to saturate financial schemes across local bodies. It aims to reach 2.70 lakh gram panchayats and urban local bodies throughout India. Banks will organize camps for enrolments and Aadhaar seeding, and update nominations in savings accounts.
items.title_hi: वित्त मंत्रालय वित्तीय समावेशन अभियान चलाएगा
items.summary_hi: वित्त मंत्रालय स्थानीय निकायों में वित्तीय योजनाओं को संतृप्त करने वाला अभियान शुरू कर रहा है। यह पहल पूरे भारत में 2.70 लाख ग्राम पंचायतों और शहरी स्थानीय निकायों तक पहुँचेगी। बैंक नामांकन और आधार सीडिंग के लिए शिविर लगाएंगे, और बचत खाते में नामांकन अपडेट करेंगे तथा अन्य वित्तीय सेवाएँ प्रदान करेंगे।

items.title: Indonesia Was Finding Its Feet. Then Came MSCI
items.text: The latest blow to Indonesia, from MSCI Inc.’s warning it’s considering removing the country from its global indexes, couldn’t have come at a worst time. Southeast Asia's largest economy appeared to be finding its feet after a rocky few years. Now, it faces an exodus of international capital.
items.summary: Indonesia's economy appeared to be finding its feet after a rocky few years. MSCI Inc. warned it might remove Indonesia from its global indexes. This could lead to an exodus of international capital from the country.
items.title_hi: Indonesia अपने पैरों पर खड़ी हो रही थी। फिर MSCI आया।
items.summary_hi: Indonesia की अर्थव्यवस्था कुछ कठिन वर्षों के बाद अपने पैरों पर खड़ी दिख रही थी। MSCI Inc. ने चेतावनी दी कि वह इंडोनेशिया को अपने वैश्विक सूचकांक से हटा सकता है। इससे विदेशी पूंजी का outflow हो सकता है।

items.title: Shiromani Akali Dal's three-phase yatra to begin & end at religious places
items.text: SAD president Sukhbir Singh Badal will launch the first phase on November 10 from Talwandi Sabo, covering more than 65 assembly constituencies in the Malwa region. The yatra will cover two constituencies every day, with Badal travelling by road in a specially designed bus and addressing party workers and gatherings along the route.
items.summary: SAD president Sukhbir Singh Badal will launch the first phase of a three‑phase yatra on November 10 from Talwandi Sabo. It will cover more than 65 assembly constituencies in the Malwa region, moving two constituencies each day. Badal will travel by road in a specially designed bus, addressing party workers and gatherings along the way.
items.title_hi: शिओromani अकाली दल की तीन‑चरण यात्रा धार्मिक स्थलों पर शुरू होगी और समाप्त होगी
items.summary_hi: शिओromani अकाली दल के अध्यक्ष सुखबीर सिंह बादल 10 नवंबर को तालवंडी सबो से पहले चरण की यात्रा शुरू करेंगे। यह यात्रा मालवा क्षेत्र के 65 से अधिक विधानसभा क्षेत्रों को कवर करेगी, प्रतिदिन दो क्षेत्रों की दूरी तय करेगी। बादल विशेष रूप से डिज़ाइन की गई बस से सड़क द्वारा यात्रा करेंगे और रास्ते में पार्टी कार्यकर्ताओं और जनसभाओं को संबोधित करेंगे।

items.title: RBI tightens scrutiny of $1 billion-plus overseas investments amid rupee pressure
items.text: The Reserve Bank of India is implementing stricter scrutiny on large overseas direct investments by Indian companies. Banks must now collect and present detailed information regarding these investments to the RBI. This initiative aims to prevent potential losses for both the companies and the Indian economy. The RBI's checklist requires banks to conduct thorough due diligence on the rationale behind each investment.
items.summary: The RBI is tightening scrutiny on overseas investments of over $1 billion by Indian companies. Banks must collect and submit detailed information on such investments to the RBI. This aims to prevent potential losses for companies and the economy.
items.title_hi: RBI ने रुपये के दबाव के बीच $1 बिलियन प्लस से अधिक विदेशी निवेशों की जाँच कड़ी की
items.summary_hi: भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक भारतीय कंपनियों द्वारा $1 बिलियन से अधिक के विदेशी direct निवेशों पर सख़्ती से जाँच कर रहा है। बैंकों को अब इन निवेशों की विस्तृत जानकारी एकत्र कर RBI को प्रस्तुत करनी होगी। इस पहल का उद्देश्य कंपनियों और भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के संभावित नुकसान को रोकना है।

items.title: Chorbagan tragedy could have been averted if Adhikari government had made proper planning: Adhir Ranjan Chowdhury
items.text: Adhir Ranjan Chowdhury said nine IPS officers, who were transferred out of Kolkata following the West Bengal assembly election results, have been brought back only after the tragedy struck.
items.summary: Adhir Ranjan Chowdhury said the Chorbagan tragedy could have been avoided if the Adhikari government had planned properly. He noted that nine IPS officers, transferred out of Kolkata after the West Bengal assembly election results, were brought back only after the tragedy.
items.title_hi: चोरबागन त्रासदी टाली जा सकती थी अगर आdhikari सरकार ने उचित योजना बनाई होती: अधीर रंजन चौधरी
items.summary_hi: अधीर रंजन चौधरी ने कहा कि चोरबागन त्रासदी टाली जा सकती थी अगर आdhikari सरकार ने उचित योजना बनाई होती। उन्होंने बताया कि पश्चिम बंगाल विधानसभा चुनाव परिणामों के बाद कोलकाता से स्थानांतरित किए गए नौ आईपीएस अधिकारी केवल त्रासदी के बाद ही वापस लाए गए।

items.title: Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council Kargil chief to seek dissolution, likely to join BJP
items.text: Akhoon, an NC leader, rebelled against the party earlier this year when he refused to step down as chief executive councillor after completing two and a half years in favour of the alliance partner Congress, as per a power-sharing arrangement. This term of the LAHDC (Kargil) will end in October 2028.
items.summary: Akhoon, an NC leader, rebelled earlier this year after refusing to step down as chief executive councillor following two and a half years in office, to favor the Congress ally under a power-sharing deal. The Kargil chief of the Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council now seeks dissolution and may join the BJP, with the council's term set to end in October 2028.
items.title_hi: Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council Kargil प्रमुख को विघटन की मांग करने की संभावना है, संभवतः BJP में शामिल हो सकते हैं
items.summary_hi: एनसी नेता अखून ने इस साल पहले पार्टी के खिलाफ विद्रोह किया जब वह two and a half years पूरे करने के बाद मुख्य कार्यकारी पार्षद का पद छोड़ने से इनकार कर दिया, ताकि कांग्रेस सहयोगी को लाभ मिल सके, जैसा कि शक्ति साझाकरण व्यवस्था के अनुसार है। लद्दाख स्वायत्त पर्वतीय विकास परिषद् कारगिल प्रमुख अब विघटन की मांग कर रहे हैं और संभवतः BJP में शामिल हो सकते हैं, क्योंकि LAHDC (Kargil) का कार्यकाल October 2028 में समाप्त होगा।

items.title: Hedge funds retreat from tech at fastest pace in a decade as AI trade weakens
items.text: Hedge funds cut technology exposure at the fastest pace in at least a decade as the global AI trade weakened and tech stocks bore the brunt of last week’s selloff. Goldman Sachs data showed funds reduced risk sharply, although technology remained a major part of their portfolios.
items.summary: Hedge funds have cut technology exposure at the fastest pace in at least a decade. This retreat follows a weakening global AI trade and a selloff that hit tech stocks hard. Goldman Sachs data shows funds reduced risk sharply, though technology remains a major part of their portfolios.
items.title_hi: हेज फंड्स टेक से सबसे तेज़ रिट्रीट कर रहे हैं क्योंकि AI ट्रेड कमजोर हो रहा है और यह दस साल में सबसे तेज़ गति है
items.summary_hi: हेज फंड्स ने पिछले दस साल में सबसे तेज़ गति से अपने टेक एक्सपोजर को कम किया है। इस पीछे हटने का कारण वैश्विक AI ट्रेड में कमजोरी और पिछले हफ्ते की बिकवाली है, जिसने टेक शेयरों को कठोर रूप से प्रभावित किया। गोल्डमैन सैक्स के आंकड़े दिखाते हैं कि फंड्स ने जोखिम को तेज़ी से कम किया है, हालांकि टेक अभी भी उनके पोर्टफोलियो का एक प्रमुख हिस्सा बना हुआ है।

items.title: Bomb Hoax On IndiGo Flight In Chennai, Fliers Deboarded, Take-Off Delayed
items.text: All passengers were offloaded by 6.55 pm as security personnel initiated the prescribed procedures, including an anti-sabotage check.
items.summary: A bomb hoax was reported on an IndiGo flight in Chennai. All passengers were offloaded by 6.55 pm as security staff carried out anti‑sabotage checks. The take‑off was delayed as a result.
items.title_hi: चेन्नई में इंडिगो फ्लाइट पर बम का झूठा संदेश, यात्री उतारे गए, टेक‑ऑफ़ देरी
items.summary_hi: चेन्नई में एक इंडिगो फ्लाइट पर बम की झूठी सूचना मिली। सभी यात्रियों को 6.55 pm तक उतार दिया गया क्योंकि सुरक्षा कर्मियों ने एंटी‑साबोटेज़ जांच शुरू की।その結果, टेक‑ऑफ़ में देरी हुई।

items.title: Inspired By Reels, 3 Friends Came Up With 'Bigshot' Plan. Why It Failed
items.text: Influenced by an Instagram reel, one minor convinced two friends, a minor and an adult, to join him in his quest to become a bigshot.
items.summary: A minor was inspired by an Instagram reel and persuaded a minor friend and an adult friend to join his plan to become a bigshot. The plan ultimately failed.
items.title_hi: रील्स से प्रेरित, 3 दोस्तों ने 'बिगशॉट' योजना बनाई. क्यों यह विफल हुई
items.summary_hi: एक नाबालिग़ ने इंस्टाग्राम रील देख कर अपने नाबालिग़ मित्र और एक वयस्क मित्र को अपने बिगशॉट बनने की योजना में शामिल होने के लिए मनाया। अंत में यह योजना विफल हो गई।

items.title: Why is Pushkar Singh Dhami shielding minister Rekha Arya, asks Congress
items.text: Congress alleged that Arya's continuation as a minister and the appointment of BJP leader Dushyant Gautam as the governor of Sikkim despite his name being linked to the Ankita Bhandari murder case were examples of moral compromises by the ruling establishment in the poll-bound state.
items.summary: Congress has questioned why Pushkar Singh Dhami is shielding minister Rekha Arya. It alleges that Arya's continued ministerial role and the appointment of BJP leader Dushyant Gautam as Sikkim's governor, despite his link to the Ankita Bhandari murder case, reflect moral compromises by the ruling establishment in the poll-bound state.
items.title_hi: कांग्रेस पूछ रही है कि पुष्कर सिंह धामी मंत्री रेखा आर्या को क्यों बचा रहे हैं?
items.summary_hi: कांग्रेस ने सवाल किया है कि पुष्कर सिंह धामी मंत्री रेखा आर्या का बचाव क्यों कर रहे हैं। वे आर्य के मंत्री पद पर बने रहने और भाजपा नेता दुष्यंत गौतम को सिक्किम का राज्यपाल नियुक्त करने के बावजूद उनके नाम का अनिता भंडारी हत्याकांड से जुड़ा होने के बावजूद इसे शासक establishment के नैतिक समझौते का उदाहरण मानते हैं, जो poll-bound state में है।

items.title: Amit Shah's Punjab visit puts drug crisis in focus ahead of polls
items.text: Shah will travel to Mansa, Sangrur and Gurdaspur to meet the families of Parvinder Singh Jhota, Gulzar Singh and Bikramjit Singh. The visit comes days after the Ministry of Home Affairs sought detailed reports from the Punjab government on the three cases.
items.summary: Amit Shah is visiting Punjab to highlight the drug crisis ahead of the polls. He will go to Mansa, Sangrur and Gurdaspur to meet the families of Parvinder Singh Jhota, Gulzar Singh and Bikramjit Singh. The trip follows a request from the Ministry of Home Affairs for detailed reports on the three cases from the Punjab government.
items.title_hi: अमित शाह का पंजाब visit चुनाव से पहले ड्रग संकट पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है
items.summary_hi: अमित शाह पolls से पहले पंजाब में ड्रग संकट को उजागर करने के लिए visita कर रहे हैं। वे मनसा, संग्रुर और गुरदासपुर जाकर परविंदर सिंह झोटा, गुलज़ार सिंह और बिक्रमजीत सिंह के परिवारों से मिलेंगे। यह visita गृह मंत्रालय द्वारा पंजाब सरकार से 3 मामलों पर विस्तृत रिपोर्ट मांगे जाने के बाद हो रही है।

items.title: Marco Rubio To Begin 3-Day India Tour Today, Will Honour 26/11 Victims
items.text: In addition to his meeting with S Jaishankar, Rubio's engagements in Mumbai included laying a wreath at the Taj memorial to honour the victims of the 26/11 terror attack.
items.summary: Marco Rubio is starting a three‑day visit to India today. As part of his Mumbai programme, he will meet S Jaishankar and lay a wreath at the Taj memorial to honour the victims of the 26/11 terror attack.
items.title_hi: मार्को rubio आज 3‑दिवसीय भारत यात्रा शुरू करेंगे और 26/11 के पीड़ितों को श्रद्धांजलि देंगे
items.summary_hi: मार्को rubio अपनी 3‑दिवसीय भारत यात्रा की शुरूआत आज कर रहे हैं। मुंबई में वे एस जयशंकर से मिलेंगे और ताज स्मारक पर श्रद्धांजलि अर्पित करके 26/11 आतंकवादी हमले के पीड़ितों को याद करेंगे।

items.title: BJP may drop 30-40% of Uttar Pradesh MLAs ahead of 2027 polls
items.text: In the 2022 assembly polls, retained BJP candidates had an 85% strike rate, compared with 77% for those brought in to replace the sitting MLAs. The 2024 Lok Sabha results told a different story: New candidates who replaced sitting MPs won 11 of 16 seats while only 20 of the 46 incumbents won.
items.summary: The BJP may drop 30-40% of its Uttar Pradesh MLAs before the 2027 elections. In the 2022 assembly polls, sitting BJP candidates had an 85% success rate, while newcomers replacing them had 77%. In the 2024 Lok Sabha results, new candidates replacing sitting MPs won 11 of 16 seats, whereas only 20 of the 46 incumbent MPs won.
items.title_hi: BJP 2027 के चुनावों से पहले उत्तर प्रदेश के 30-40% एमएलए को हटा सकती है
items.summary_hi: BJP अपने उत्तर प्रदेश के 30-40% एमएलए को 2027 के चुनावों से पहले हटा सकती है। 2022 के विधानसभा चुनावों में, मौजूदा BJP उम्मीदवारों की सफलता दर 85% थी, जबकि उनके स्थान पर लाए गए उम्मीदवारों की दर 77% थी। 2024 के लोकसभा परिणामों में, बैठे हुए MPs के स्थान पर आए नए उम्मीदवारों ने 16 में से 11 सीटें जीतीं, जबकि केवल 46 में से 20 मौजूदा MPs जीते।

items.title: Dussehra 2026: Dry Day Restrictions, Bank Closures And What's Open Or Closed
items.text: From liquor shops to banks, here are detailed guidelines regarding commercial operations and public services on Dussehra 2026.
items.summary: On Dussehra 2026, there will be dry day restrictions and bank closures. Guidelines detail which commercial operations and public services will be open or closed.
items.title_hi: दुस्सहरा 2026: शुष्क दिवस प्रतिबंध, बैंक बंद और क्या खुला या बंद है
items.summary_hi: दुस्सहरा 2026 पर शुष्क दिवस प्रतिबंध और बैंक बंद रहेंगे। दिशानिर्देश बताते हैं कि कौन से वाणिज्यिक संचालन और सार्वजनिक सेवाएं खुली या बंद रहेंगी।

items.title: Uneven rains may keep price of spices elevated
items.text: Southern India is currently grappling with challenges in spice production, primarily due to uneven monsoon patterns and parched soil, which are adversely affecting harvest yields. Despite expanding cultivation areas, turmeric yields are predicted to plummet owing to unfavorable weather. Additionally, delays in red chilli sowing in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana could lead to surging market prices.
items.summary: Uneven monsoon patterns and dry soil are reducing spice harvest yields in Southern India. Turmeric production is expected to fall significantly, while delayed red chilli sowing in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana may push market prices higher.
items.title_hi: असमान वर्षा मसालों की कीमतें बढ़ाए रख सकती है
items.summary_hi: असमान मानसून पैटर्न और शुष्क मिट्टी दक्षिण भारत में मसालों की फसल की उपज को कम कर रही है। हल्दी की उत्पादन में भारी गिरावट की आशा है, जबकि आंध्र प्रदेश और तेलंगाना में लाल मिर्च की बुवाई में देरी से बाजार की कीमतें बढ़ सकती हैं।

items.title: Jio Platforms IPO listing: Can Reliance overtake Tata Group as India’s largest conglomerate by market cap? Details
items.text: A potential Jio Platforms IPO, valued at about ₹10.3 lakh crore, could lift Reliance Group’s combined market capitalisation to ₹28.35 lakh crore, overtaking Tata Group’s ₹25.92 lakh crore. Adani ranks third at ₹17.23 lakh crore, followed by HDFC Group at nearly ₹13.9 lakh crore.
items.summary: A potential Jio Platforms IPO is valued at about ₹10.3 lakh crore. If listed, Reliance Group’s combined market capitalisation could rise to ₹28.35 lakh crore, overtaking Tata Group’s ₹25.92 lakh crore. Adani would rank third at ₹17.23 lakh crore and HDFC Group nearly ₹13.9 lakh crore.
items.title_hi: Jio Platforms IPO लिस्टिंग: क्या रिलायंस टाटा ग्रुप को पीछे छोड़ कर भारत का सबसे बड़ा समूह बनने के बाजार पूंजीकरण में आगे बढ़ सकती है? विवरण
items.summary_hi: संभावित Jio Platforms IPO का मूल्य लगभग ₹10.3 लाख करोड़ है। यदि लिस्ट होती है, तो रिलायंस ग्रुप की संयुक्त बाजार पूंजी ₹28.35 लाख करोड़ तक बढ़ सकती है, जिससे टाटा ग्रुप के ₹25.92 लाख करोड़ को पीछे छोड़ दिया जा सकता है। अडानी तीसरे स्थान पर ₹17.23 लाख करोड़ होगा और एचडीएफसी ग्रुप लगभग ₹13.9 लाख करोड़ रहेगा।

items.title: India-New Zealand FTA comes into effect today
items.text: The FTA will provide Indian exporters with 100% duty-free access to the New Zealand market, opening opportunities for MSMEs, women entrepreneurs, farmers and artisans. This is expected to facilitate $20 billion in investments into India in 15 years that would create opportunities across manufacturing, infrastructure, agriculture, and innovation.
items.summary: The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement has taken effect, giving Indian exporters full duty-free access to the New Zealand market. It is expected to attract $20 billion of investment into India over the next 15 years, benefiting MSMEs, women entrepreneurs, farmers and artisans.
items.title_hi: भारत-न्यूजीलैंड एफटीए आज से प्रभावी हो गया
items.summary_hi: भारत-न्यूजीलैंड स्वतंत्र व्यापार समझौते ने प्रभावी होना शुरू कर दिया है, जिससे भारतीय निर्यातकों को न्यूजीलैंड बाजार में पूर्ण शुल्क‑मुक्त पहुँच मिल गई है। इसके कारण अगले 15 वर्षों में भारत में $20 बिलियन का निवेश आकर्षित होने की उम्मीद है, जो एमएसएमई, महिला उद्यमियों, किसानों और शिल्पकारों को लाभ पहुंचाएगा।

items.title: Jio IPO anchor book sees over 30x demand, draws record bids worth ₹2.5 trn
items.text: Jio Platforms' ₹8,110 crore anchor book draws bids exceeding ₹2.5 trillion, with global investors, mutual funds and insurers competing for shares ahead of its ₹30,213 crore IPO
items.summary: Jio Platforms' ₹8,110 crore anchor book drew bids exceeding ₹2.5 trillion, with global investors, mutual funds and insurers competing for shares ahead of its ₹30,213 crore IPO. The title notes demand was over 30 times the anchor book size.
items.title_hi: Jio IPO एंकर बुक को 30x से अधिक मांग देखी गई, ₹2.5 ट्रिलियन के रिकॉर्ड बिड आकर्षित किए
items.summary_hi: Jio Platforms के ₹8,110 करोड़ के एंकर बुक में ₹2.5 ट्रिलियन से अधिक की बोलियां आईं। वैश्विक निवेशक, म्यूचुअल फंड और बीमा कंपनियाँ इसके ₹30,213 करोड़ IPO से पहले शेयरों के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा कर रही हैं। शीर्षक के अनुसार मांग 30x से अधिक रही।

items.title: S&P Global flags potentially hidden AI debt at hyperscalers as AI spending surges
items.text: S&P Global warned that hyperscalers could be carrying more AI related debt than currently visible through financing structures linked to data centres and smaller AI firms. Despite rising concerns around AI infrastructure debt, the agency saw no immediate need for rating changes, while flagging profitability and escalating investment as key risks.
items.summary: S&P Global warned that hyperscalers might have more AI-related debt than visible through financing structures linked to data centres and smaller AI firms. Despite rising concerns about AI infrastructure debt, the agency saw no immediate need for rating changes. It flagged profitability and escalating investment as key risks.
items.title_hi: S&P Global ने हाइपर्सकैलर्स पर संभावित रूप से छिपी हुई AI ऋण को चिह्नित किया जब AI खर्च में वृद्धि हुई
items.summary_hi: S&P Global ने चेतावनी दी कि हाइपर्सकैलर्स के पास वित्तीय संरचनाओं के माध्यम से दिखाई देने वाली तुलना में अधिक AI‑संबंधित ऋण हो सकता है, जो डेटा सेंटर और छोटी AI फर्मों से जुड़ी हैं। AI इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर ऋण के आसपास बढ़ती चिंताओं के बावजूद, एजेंसी ने तुरंत रेटिंग परिवर्तन की कोई आवश्यकता नहीं देखी। इसने लाभप्रदता और बढ़ते निवेश को मुख्य जोखिम के रूप में उजागर किया।

items.title: Already a hit? Reliance's Jio Platforms gets ₹8,110 cr from anchor investors; LIC, New World Fund among top investors
items.text: Jio Platforms allotted shares worth ₹8,110 crore to 212 anchor investors at ₹1,119 per share ahead of its October 21 IPO. LIC received the largest allocation. The company aims to raise about ₹30,213 crore, valuing it at approximately $108 billion at the top of its price band.
items.summary: Jio Platforms allotted shares worth ₹8,110 crore to 212 anchor investors at ₹1,119 per share ahead of its October 21 IPO. LIC received the largest allocation among those investors. The company aims to raise about ₹30,213 crore, valuing it at approximately $108 billion at the top of its price band.
items.title_hi: पहले से ही हिट? रिलायंस के जियो प्लेटफ़ॉर्म्स को एंकर निवेशकों से ₹8,110 करोड़ मिले; LIC, न्यू वर्ल्ड फंड शीर्ष निवेशकों में शामिल
items.summary_hi: जियो प्लेटफ़ॉर्म्स ने 212 एंकर निवेशकों को ₹1,119 प्रति शेयर के दर पर ₹8,110 करोड़ मूल्य के शेयर आवंटित किए, अक्टूबर 21 के आईपीओ से पहले। LIC को उनमें से सबसे बड़ा आवंटन मिला। कंपनी लगभग ₹30,213 करोड़ जुटाने का लक्ष्य रखती है, जिससे इसके मूल्य का अनुमान लगभग $108 बिलियन लगाया जाता है, कीमत बैंड के शीर्ष पर।

items.title: Varmora Granito Q2 results: Profit more than triples to ₹44 crore, revenue rises 9%
items.summary: Profit more than tripled to ₹44 crore. Revenue rose 9%.
items.title_hi: Varmora Granito Q2 परिणाम: लाभ तीन गुना से अधिक होकर ₹44 करोड़ हो गया, आय 9% बढ़ी
items.summary_hi: लाभ तीन गुना से अधिक होकर ₹44 करोड़ हो गया। आय 9% बढ़ी।

items.title: Tariff quota notified for New Zealand fruits, honey
items.text: Kiwifruit imports will qualify for zero customs duty under the tariff rate quota (TRQ), subject to a minimum CIF value of $1.80 per kg while 40 tonnes of New Zealand-certified Manuka honey under the quota have been permitted for 2026. The annual limit will increase to 200 tonnes from 2027.
items.summary: Under the notified tariff rate quota, kiwifruit imports face zero customs duty if their CIF value is at least $1.80 per kilogram. Up to 40 tonnes of certified Manuka honey from New Zealand are allowed in 2026, with the annual limit rising to 200 tonnes starting in 2027.
items.title_hi: न्यूजीलैंड फल, शहद के लिए टैरिफ कोटा अधिसूचित
items.summary_hi: सूचित टैरिफ दर कोटा के तहत, कीविफ्रूट आयात शुल्क मुक्त होगा यदि उनका CIF मूल्य कम से कम $1.80 प्रति किलोग्राम हो। 2026 में अधिकतम 40 टन प्रमाणित मणुका शहद न्यूजीलैंड से अनुमति दी गई है, और वार्षिक सीमा 2027 से बढ़कर 200 टन हो जाएगी।

items.title: Piramal Finance Q2FY27 results: Net profit zooms 67% to ₹545 crore
items.text: Non-bank lender Piramal Finance on Monday reported a 67 per cent jump in net profit to Rs 545 crore for the September quarter, helped by core income growth and improvements in costs. The company's core net interest income grew 35 per cent to Rs 1,530 crore due to a 24 per cent growth in assets under management and a 0.35 per cent expansion in net income margin to 6.5 per cent. The cost-to-income ratio improved sharply to 52.1 per cent during the reporting quarter from 61.2 per cent, helping the bottom line. items.summary: Net profit jumped 67% to ₹545 crore. Core net interest income rose 35% to ₹1,530 crore, assets under management grew 24%, and cost-to-income ratio improved to 52.1%.
items.title_hi: Piramal Finance Q2FY27 परिणाम: शुद्ध लाभ 67% बढ़कर ₹545 करोड़ हो गया
items.summary_hi: शुद्ध लाभ 67% बढ़कर ₹545 करोड़ हो गया। core net interest income 35% बढ़कर ₹1,530 करोड़ हो गया, assets under management 24% बढ़ी, और cost-to-income ratio 52.1% हो गया।

items.title: Eyes on Wall Street: General Motors shares in focus ahead of 3rd quarter results - Key factors investors should watch
items.text: General Motors shares fall 1.86% ahead of October 20 earnings announcement; analysts forecast Q3 revenue at $48.76 billion

items.title: Punjab & Sind Bank Q2 net profit surges 40% to ₹412 cr on improved income
items.text: Punjab & Sind Bank on Saturday reported a 40 per cent jump in net profit to Rs 412 crore for the second quarter ended September 30, helped by improved core income and reduction in bad assets. The public sector lender posted a net profit of Rs 295 crore in the same period of the previous fiscal. The bank's total income increased to Rs 3,747 crore in the second quarter from Rs 3,373 crore a year ago, Punjab & Sind Bank said in a regulatory filing. items.summary: Punjab & Sind Bank's net profit surged 40% to ₹412 crore in Q2. The bank's total income rose to ₹3,747 crore from ₹3,373 crore a year earlier. Interest income increased to ₹3,394 crore from ₹2,999 crore.

items.title: Just Dial Q2 profit declines 9.73% to ₹107.8 cr despite 13% revenue growth
items.text: Just Dial Ltd, a leading local search engine, has reported a decline of 9.73 per cent in its consolidated net profit to Rs 107.8 crore in the September quarter of FY27, on a year-on-year basis. It had posted a net profit of Rs 119.44 crore in the July-September quarter a year ago, according to a regulatory filing. However, Just Dial's revenue from operations was up 13.11 per cent in the September quarter at Rs 342.82 crore, compared to Rs 303.07 crore in the corresponding quarter a year ago. Just Dial's total expenses stood at Rs 262.81 crore, up 14.6 per cent YoY in the September quarter. The
items.summary: Just Dial's net profit fell 9.73% to Rs 107.8 crore in the September quarter of FY27. Its revenue from operations rose 13.11% to Rs 342.82 crore year-on-year. Total expenses increased 14.6% to Rs 262.81 crore.
items.title_hi: जस्ट डायल Q2 लाभ 9.73% गिरकर ₹107.8 cr despite 13% revenue growth

items.key_numbers: Profit Rs 107.8 crore (-9.73% YoY) · Revenue Rs 342.82 crore (+13.11% YoY)

items.title: Ireda Q2 net profit edges up at ₹554 crore, loan disbursements rise 31%
items.text: State-owned Ireda has posted a marginal rise in its standalone net profit to Rs 554 crore for the September quarter, the company said on Monday. It earned a net profit of Rs 549 crore in the second quarter of the preceding financial year, the Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (Ireda) said in a statement. In July-September, the company's revenue from operations rose 14 per cent to Rs 2,345 crore from Rs 2,057 crore a year ago. items.summary: Ireda's Q2 net profit rose slightly to ₹554 crore from ₹549 crore a year earlier. Revenue from operations increased 14% to ₹2,345 crore, and loan disbursements grew 31% to ₹10,579 crore.

This quarter also marked an 11% rise in net worth, showcasing Ireda's strength in renewable energy financing and management of asset quality.

items.summary_hi: Bajaj Finance का शुद्ध लाभ सितंबर तिमाही में वर्ष‑on‑वर्ष 29% बढ़कर Rs 6,367 करोड़ हो गया। इसका शुद्ध ब्याज आय 24% बढ़कर Rs 13,335 करोड़ हो गई। कुल आय 23% बढ़कर Rs 15,974 करोड़ हो गई।

items.title: Elon Musk pledges a share of SpaceX company to 'every kid in America'
items.text: In a groundbreaking move, Elon Musk revealed his intention to distribute one share of SpaceX to every child in America. This announcement comes on the heels of Anthropic's commitment to allocate 5 percent of its shares to a public benefit fund aimed at harmonizing financial success with social impacts. With SpaceX recently hitting the stock market, Musk has also claimed the title of the world's first trillionaire.
items.summary: Elon Musk said he will give one SpaceX share to each child in America. Anthropic promised to allocate 5 percent of its shares to a public benefit fund. SpaceX recently began trading and Musk said he is the world's first trillionaire.
items.title_hi: Elon Musk ने हर अमेरिकी बच्चे को SpaceX का एक हिस्सा देने की प्रतिबद्धता जताई
items.summary_hi: Elon Musk ने कहा कि वह हर अमेरिकी बच्चे को एक SpaceX शेयर देंगे। Anthropic ने अपने शेयरों का 5 प्रतिशत एक सार्वजनिक लाभ फंड में आवंटित करने का वादा किया। SpaceX हाल ही में शेयर बाजार में आने लगी और Musk ने कहा कि वह दुनिया के पहले ट्रिलियनेयर हैं।

items.title: NABVENTURES plans Rs 30-70 crore bets on growth-stage firms in Fund II
items.text: NABVENTURES aims to invest ₹30-70 crore per company in agriculture, rural financial services, and climate solutions. The venture capital arm plans to focus on technology-driven businesses and growth-stage companies with established traction. Larger initial checks will be adapted for follow-on funding in high-performing portfolio companies. The emphasis will be on sustainable scaling in large markets, improving productivity, and raising farmers' incomes.
items.summary: NABVENTURES plans to invest between 30 and 70 crore rupees per company in agriculture, rural financial services, and climate solutions. It will focus on technology-driven, growth-stage businesses with established traction. The fund aims for sustainable scaling, higher productivity, and increased farmer incomes.
items.title_hi: NABVENTURES 30-70 करोड़ रुपये के दांव लगाती है वृद्धि‑चरण वाली कंपनियों पर फंड II में
items.summary_hi: NABVENTURES प्रति कंपनी 30 से 70 करोड़ रुपये का निवेश कृषि, ग्रामीण वित्तीय सेवाओं और जलवायु समाधानों में करेगी। यह प्रौद्योगिकी‑आधारित, वृद्धि‑चरण वाले व्यवसायों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करेगी जिनकी स्थापित पकड़ है। फंड का लक्ष्य स्थिर पैमाने पर वृद्धि, उत्पादकता में वृद्धि और किसानों की आय बढ़ाना है

items.title: Trump waives Russia sanctions, easing India’s energy concerns as US trade deal nears
items.text: US President Donald Trump waived key Russian sanctions which may enhance trade relations with India. This decision is expected to provide negotiating space for a potential trade deal. India, one of the largest importers of Russian oil, faces challenges due to declining imports. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is visiting India to discuss cooperation on this matter. The waiver could help India secure more favorable tariffs while stabilizing energy policies.
items.summary: US President Donald Trump has waived key Russian sanctions, which may improve trade relations with India. The waiver is expected to create negotiating space for a potential US‑India trade deal and help stabilize India's energy policies.
items.title_hi: ट्रंप ने रूस पर प्रतिबंध हटाए, भारत की ऊर्जा चिंताएँ कम हुईं क्योंकि US‑India व्यापार समझौता निकट है
items.summary_hi: अमेरिका के राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप ने मुख्य रूसी प्रतिबंध हटा दिए हैं, जिससे भारत के साथ व्यापार संबंधों में सुधार हो सकता है। यह छूट US‑India व्यापार समझौते के लिए वार्ता के स्थान बनाए रखने की उम्मीद है और भारत की ऊर्जा नीति को स्थिर बनाने में मदद कर सकती है

items.title: METALS-Copper falls as LME stocks edge higher and mine supply concerns ease
items.text: Copper prices have dipped due to rising inventories culminating from a resolution of a major strike at a Chilean mine. With available copper stocks hitting a two-month peak following substantial inflows, expert analyst Daniel Ghali pointed to US tariffs impacting global supply chains and shipping costs. In contrast, China exhibits signs of economic growth, notwithstanding ongoing struggles in its property sector.
items.summary: Copper prices fell as inventories rose after a major strike at a Chilean mine ended, pushing stocks to a two‑month high. Analyst Daniel Ghali noted US tariffs affecting supply chains and shipping costs, while China shows economic growth despite property sector issues.
items.title_hi: METALS-Copper गिर रहा है क्योंकि LME स्टॉक बढ़ रहे हैं और खदान आपूर्ति चिंताएं कम हो रही हैं
items.summary_hi: कॉपर की कीमतें इसलिए गिरीं क्योंकि एक चिलीयन खदान में हड़ताल समाप्त होने के बाद inventories बढ़ीं, जिससे stocks two‑month के उच्च स्तर पर पहुँच गए। विश्लेषक Daniel Ghali ने US टैरिफ़्स जो सप्लाई चेन और शिपिंग लागत को प्रभावित करते हैं, का उल्लेख किया जबकि चीन आर्थिक वृद्धि दिखा रहा है हालांकि संपत्ति क्षेत्र की समस्याओं बनी हुई हैं।

items.text: Sterling hit a fresh 17-month high against the euro on Monday as street riots in France and elevated energy prices weighed on the single currency while recent
items.summary: Sterling rose to a 17‑month high versus the euro on Monday. The euro weakened due to street riots in France and higher energy prices.

items.title: UDF convenor dares V.D. Satheesan reveal name of ‘anonymous benefactor’ who sponsored his chartered flight
items.text: Adoor Prakash told a television channel that V.D. Satheeshan had a moral obligation to clear the politically controversial ambiguity surrounding his ‘obstinate refusal’ to name the person or entity who sponsored the private chartered flight
items.summary: UDF convenor Adoor Prakash challenged V.D. Satheesan to disclose the anonymous benefactor who funded his chartered flight. He said Satheesan has a moral obligation to clarify his refusal to name the sponsor. The statement was made on a television channel.
items.title_hi: यूडीएफ संयोजक वी.डी. सतीशन को चुनौती देता है कि वे अपने निजी विमान की स्पॉन्सर करने वाले ‘गोपनीय लाभदाता’ का नाम खोलें
items.summary_hi: यूडीएफ संयोजक अदूर प्रकाश ने वी.डी. सतीशन को चुनौती दी कि वे अपने निजी विमान की स्पॉन्सर करने वाले गोपनीय लाभदाता का नाम खोलें। उन्होंने कहा कि सतीशन का नैतिक कर्तव्य है कि वे स्पॉन्सर का नाम न बताने वाली अपनी अस्पष्टता को स्पष्ट करें। यह बयान एक टेलीविजन चैनल पर दिया गया।

items.title: POSH compliance in public sector banks: CIC remands RTI appeal for ‘fair hearing’
items.text: The applicant, Chayan Ghosh Chowdhury, cited the Supreme Court’s decision in Aureliano Fernandes vs State of Goa case and claimed that banks had failed to constitute Internal Committees as required under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
items.summary: Chayan Ghosh Chowdhury filed an RTI appeal citing the Supreme Court’s decision in the Aureliano Fernandes vs State of Goa case. He claimed that public sector banks had not formed Internal Committees as required by the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013. The Central Information Commission remanded the appeal for a fair hearing.
items.title_hi: सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के बैंकों में POSH पालन: CIC ने RTI अपील को ‘सुनवाई के लिए’ भेजा
items.summary_hi: Chayan Ghosh Chowdhury ने Aureliano Fernandes vs State of Goa मामले के Supreme Court के निर्णय का हवाला देते हुए RTI अपील दायर की। उन्होंने कहा कि सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के बैंकों ने Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 के तहत Internal Committees का गठन नहीं किया। CIC ने अपील को उचित सुनवाई के लिए वापस भेज दिया।

items.title: The Howdah Bearers | Mysuru's Dasara elephants
items.text: Kings stopped riding it in 1969. The elephants never stopped carrying it. This year, Mysuru has picked the next elephant.
items.summary: Kings stopped riding the howdah on elephants in 1969, but the elephants continued to carry it. This year, Mysuru selected the next elephant to bear the howdah during Dasara.

items.summary_hi: 1969 में राजा howdah पर हाथी की सवारी करना बंद कर दिए, लेकिन हाथी उसे ले जाना जारी रखे। इस साल, मैसूरु ने दशहरा के लिए अगला हाथी चुना जो howdah उठाएगा।

items.text: Under the Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, the procedure can be done till 20 weeks of gestation period in ordinary cases and 24 weeks in certain categories such as rape survivors

items.title: YSRCP Moves Supreme Court Alleging Violence Prevented Its Candidates From Filing Nominations For AP Municipal Polls
items.text: The party has sought extension of the nomination deadline, which expired on October 18, and police protection for candidates.
items.summary: YSRCP approached the Supreme Court claiming violence stopped its candidates from filing nominations for AP Municipal Polls. It requested an extension of the nomination deadline, which had expired on October 18, and asked for police protection for its candidates.

items.summary_hi: YSRCP ने सुप्रीम कोर्ट का रुख किया, दावा करते हुए कि हिंसा ने उसके उम्मीदवारों को AP नगरपालिका चुनावों के लिए नामांकन दाखिल करने से रोका। उसने नामांकन अंतिम तिथि के विस्तार की मांग की, जो 18 अक्टूबर को समाप्त हो चुकी थी, और अपने उम्मीदवारों के लिए पुलिस सुरक्षा मांगी।

items.title: AISA chief Neha Bora moves Delhi HC against police notice over ‘keeping peace’ bond
items.text: Neha Bora, President of All India Students' Association, is contesting a notice from the Delhi Police. This notice requests her to execute a bond to maintain peace during an ongoing enquiry. Bora was previously detained while heading to a protest but later released. Her petition claims the notice lacks substantial information regarding the alleged breach of peace. The legal proceedings are argued to suppress peaceful dissent and violate constitutional rights.
items.summary: AISA chief Neha Bora has moved the Delhi High Court challenging a police notice that asks her to sign a bond to keep the peace. She says the notice lacks enough information about the alleged breach of peace and that her earlier detention while going to a protest was followed by release. Her petition argues the proceedings aim to suppress peaceful dissent and breach constitutional rights.
items.title_hi: AISA प्रमुख नेहा बोरा ने पुलिस नोटिस के खिलाफ दिल्ली उच्च न्यायालय में याचिका दायर की ‘शांति बनाए रखने’ के बांड के संबंध में
items.summary_hi: एआईएसए प्रमुख नेहा बोरा ने दिल्ली उच्च न्यायालय में एक पुलिस नोटिस के खिलाफ याचिका दायर की है जो उनसे शांति बनाए रखने का बांड देने को कहता है। वह कहती हैं कि नोटिस में कथित शांति भंग के बारे में पर्याप्त जानकारी नहीं है और उनका tidligere हिरासत में लिए जाने के बाद रिहा होना हुआ था। उनकी याचिका का तर्क है कि कार्यवाही शांतिपूर्ण असहमति को दबाने और संवैधानिक अधिकारों का उल्लंघन करने के लिए की जा रही है।

items.title: Shivakumar urges PM to address cane growers’ demands as agitation delays crushing season
items.text: Chief Minister DK Shivakumar has appealed to PM Modi regarding the struggles of sugarcane farmers. Protests have intensified in North Karnataka, impacting the sugarcane crushing season and farmers’ livelihoods. The Chief Minister emphasized the urgent need for raising sugar's minimum selling price and revising ethanol procurement norms. State government initiatives to support farmers include direct financial assistance and improvements in sugar recovery rates.
items.summary: Chief Minister DK Shivakumar appealed to PM Modi about sugarcane farmers' struggles. Protests in North Karnataka have delayed the crushing season and affected livelihoods. He urged raising the minimum selling price of sugar and revising ethanol procurement norms, noting state support like direct financial aid and better sugar recovery.

items.title: CareEdge Global IFSC to sell 19.8% stake to State Bank of India, NSEIX
items.text: Care Edge Ratings on Monday said it has decided to sell a 19.8 per cent stake in its wholly-owned subsidiary CareEdge Global IFSC to State Bank of India and NSE IFSC. The company has executed share purchase agreements and a shareholders' agreement with State Bank of India (SBI) and NSE IFSC (NSEIX) to sell a 9.9 per cent equity stake each in CareEdge Global IFSC Ltd (CGIL), Care Edge Ratings said in a regulatory filing. After the share transfer is completed, the company will continue to hold an 80.2 per cent equity stake in CGIL, it said. The deal is expected to be concluded within two months,
items.summary: Care Edge Ratings decided to sell a 19.8 per cent stake in its subsidiary CareEdge Global IFSC to State Bank of India and NSE IFSC. "Last fiscal, the exports were USD 122 billion, and this financial year, we are expecting it to reach an all-time high of USD 150 billion," he said. items.summary: Engineering exports are expected to reach an all‑time high of USD 150 billion this fiscal, up from USD 122 billion last fiscal, according to EEPC Chairman Pankaj Chadha. Shipments are showing healthy growth in markets such as the United States, driven by sectors like iron and steel and machinery.

items.title: Tiger Shroff firing case: Raut slams Fadnavis govt over law and order; says regime change needed
items.text: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut criticised Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis over what he claimed to be a series of shootings, murders, extortion and kidnappings in the state. He asserted that the "regime change" slogans were vindicated by his claims that the state's home department was being used to target and jail opponents while allowing miscreants to operate freely. Congress leader Prithviraj Chavan also criticised the CM over the alleged deterioration of law and order in the state.
items.summary: Sanjay Raut of Shiv Sena (UBT) criticised Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis for alleged shootings, murders, extortion and kidnappings in the state. He said the regime change slogans were justified because the home department was allegedly targeting opponents while letting miscreants operate freely. Congress leader Prithviraj Chavan also criticised the Chief Minister over the claimed deterioration of law and order.

items.summary_hi: Shiv Sena (UBT) के नेता Sanjay Raut ने महाराष्ट्र के मुख्यमंत्री Devendra Fadnavis पर राज्य में कथित रूप से हुई गोलीबारी, हत्या, जबरन वसूली और अपहरण की श्रृंखला के लिए आलोचना की। उन्होंने कहा कि "regime change" के नारे इसलिए सही हैं क्योंकि राज्य के गृह विभाग allegedly विरोधियों को लक्ष्यित करके जेल में डाल रहा है जबकि आपराधिक तत्वों को自由 काम करने दे रहा है। कांग्रेस नेता Prithviraj Chavan ने भी मुख्यमंत्री पर prétendida कानून और व्यवस्था की स्थिति में गिरावट के लिए आलोचना की।

items.title: Starlink, Ambani’s venture should get equal treatment, let consumers decide: Shashi Tharoor
items.text: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor emphasized that SpaceX CEO Elon Musk's Starlink should follow the same licensing process as others. Tharoor highlighted that the government stated all companies are facing equal delays in the market. He mentioned various factors would influence consumer choices regarding satellite internet services. Musk expressed concerns about the obstacles Starlink faces in obtaining a license in India.
items.summary: Shashi Tharoor said Starlink should receive equal treatment and that consumers should decide. He noted that Starlink should follow the same licensing process as others and that the government said all companies face equal market delays. He added that various factors affect consumer choices, while Musk expressed concerns about obstacles Starlink faces in getting a license in India.

items.summary: A public audit in two Delhi booths found over 100 voters incorrectly marked as absent, shifted, or dead. Voters who have lived at the same address for many decades say they were labelled untraceable, absent, or permanently shifted. They state that re-enrolling via Form 6 is their only recourse.
items.title_hi: दिल्ली SIR: दो बूथों में सार्वजनिक ऑडिट पाया गया कि over 100 मतदाता गलती से अनुपस्थित, स्थानांतरित या मृत चिह्नित किए गए
items.summary_hi: दिल्ली के दो बूथों में सार्वजनिक ऑडिट से over 100 मतदाताओं को गलती से अनुपस्थित, स्थानांतरित या मृत पाया गया। उसी पते पर multiple decades से रहने वाले मतदाताओं का कहना है कि उन्हें ‘untraceable’, ‘absent’, या स्थायी रूप से स्थानांतरित चिह्नित किया गया। वे कहते हैं कि फॉर्म 6 के माध्यम से फिर से नामांकन करना उनका唯一 उपाय है।

items.title: Delhi Police grants Congress NOC for November 1 rally at Ramlila Maidan
items.text: On September 30, the INDIA bloc finalised a joint action plan over the SIR (Special Intensive Revision) row, including rallies and ‘save democracy marches’
items.summary: Delhi Police gave the Congress party a no‑objection certificate to hold a rally on 1 November at Ramlila Maidan. On 30 September, the INDIA bloc agreed on a joint plan that includes rallies and “save democracy” marches to address the SIR (Special Intensive Revision) issue.
items.title_hi: दिल्ली पुलिस ने कांग्रेस को 1 नवंबर को रामलीला मैदान में रैली के लिए एनओसी दी
items.summary_hi: दिल्ली पुलिस ने कांग्रेस पार्टी को 1 नवंबर को रामलीला मैदान में रैली करने के लिए अनापत्ति प्रमाणपत्र दिया। 30 सितंबर को INDIA ब्लॉक ने SIR (विशेष गहन संशोधन) मुद्दे पर रैलियों और ‘लोकतंत्र बचाओ’ मार्चों को शामिल करके एक संयुक्त कार्य योजना बनाई।

items.title: 70 religious congregations in J&K, Ladakh delivered Friday sermons on common theme: Muttahida Majlis-e-Ulema
items.text: “In a first-of-its-kind collective religious initiative, more than 70 major Friday congregations across Kashmir, Jammu and Ladakh responded to the call of the the MMU and delivered the sermon on the common theme of imaan (faith) on Friday, October 16,” says a spokesman of the MMU
items.summary: More than 70 major Friday congregations across Kashmir, Jammu and Ladakh delivered sermons on a common theme of faith. This followed a call from the Muttahida Majlis-e-Ulema. The sermons were given on Friday, October 16.
items.title_hi: 70 धार्मिक सम्मेलन J&K, लदाख में शुक्रवार के उपदेश सामान्य विषय पर दिए गए: Muttahida Majlis-e-Ulema
items.summary_hi: कश्मीर, जम्मू और लदाख में 70 से अधिक प्रमुख शुक्रवार की बैठकों में धर्म के सामान्य विषय पर उपदेश दिया गया। यह Muttahida Majlis-e-Ulema के आह्वान के बाद हुआ। उपदेश शुक्रवार, 16 अक्टूबर को दिए गए।

items.title: Sahil Wakode death: Parents demand arrest of IIT Bombay professors as student groups protest at Azad Maidan
items.text: The protesters demanded action against Suryanarayana Doolla, Professor of Energy Science and Engineering, and Professor Shireesh B. Kedare, Director of IIT Bombay, along with a transparent investigation and stronger safeguards against caste discrimination
items.summary: Parents of Sahil Wakode demanded the arrest of IIT Bombay professors following his death. Student groups protested at Azad Maidan, calling for action against Professor Suryanarayana Doolla and Professor Shireesh B. Kedare. They also asked for a transparent investigation and stronger safeguards against caste discrimination.
items.title_hi: साहिल वकोडे की मृत्यु: माता‑पिता IIT बंबई प्रोफेसरों की गिरफ्तारी की मांग करते हैं, छात्र समूह आजाद मैदान में प्रदर्शन कर रहे हैं
items.summary_hi: साहिल वकोडे के माता‑पिता ने उनकी मृत्यु के बाद IIT बंबई प्रोफेसरों की गिरफ्तारी की मांग की। छात्र समूहों ने आजाद मैदान में प्रदर्शन किया और प्रोफेसर सूर्यनारायण डूला और प्रोफेसर शिरीश बी. केडरे के खिलाफ कार्रवाई की मांग की। उन्होंने पारदर्शी जांच और जाति भेदभाव के खिलाफ मजबूत सुरक्षा उपायों की भी मांग की।

items.title: El Niño could intensify stress on Keralam’s forests and wildlife
items.text: According to the Forest Survey of India, Keralam reported 49 large forest fire incidents so far this year, compared with 52 in 2025. The amount and distribution of northeast monsoon rainfall will be crucial in determining water availability in forests and the extent of water stress on wildlife
items.summary: El Niño could intensify stress on Keralam’s forests and wildlife. According to the Forest Survey of India, Keralam reported 49 large forest fire incidents so far this year, compared with 52 in 2025, and the amount and distribution of northeast monsoon rainfall will be crucial for water availability and wildlife water stress.
items.title_hi: El Niño Keralam के जंगलों और वन्यजीवों पर तनाव बढ़ा सकता है
items.summary_hi: El Niño Keralam के जंगलों और वन्यजीवों पर तनाव बढ़ा सकता है। Forest Survey of India के अनुसार, Keralam ने अब तक इस साल 49 बड़े वन अग्निकांड की घटनाएं raport की हैं, 2025 में 52 थीं, और उत्तर‑पश्चिम मानसून बारिश की मात्रा और वितरण वन में पानी की उपलब्धता और वन्यजीवों पर जल तनाव के लिए महत्वपूर्ण होगी।

items.title: Left student outfits to take out march to Lok Bhavan in Keralam on October 23
items.text: The march, demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, will be inaugurated by Leader of the Opposition Pinarayi Vijayan; leaders of the Communist Party of India and the Socialist Unity Centre of India (Communist) will also participate in the protest
items.summary: Left student outfits will take out a march to Lok Bhavan in Keralam on October 23. The march demands the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. It will be inaugurated by Leader of the Opposition Pinarayi Vijayan, with leaders of the Communist Party of India and the Socialist Unity Centre of India (Communist) also participating.
items.title_hi: Left student outfits Lok Bhavan, Keralam में 23 अक्टूबर को मार्च निकालेंगे
items.summary_hi: Left student outfits Lok Bhavan, Keralam में 23 अक्टूबर को मार्च निकालेंगे। मार्च मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त Gyanesh Kumar की हटाने की मांग करता है। इस मार्च का उद्घाटन विपक्ष के नेता Pinarayi Vijayan करेंगे, और Communist Party of India तथा Socialist Unity Centre of India (Communist) के नेता भी भाग लेंगे।

items.text: Gold was little changed as traders weighed easing bets on an imminent Federal Reserve rate hike against a surge in oil prices that pushed Treasury yields higher.
items.summary: Gold remained steady as traders eased their bets on an imminent Federal Reserve rate hike. At the same time, a rise in oil prices pushed Treasury yields higher.

items.summary_hi: सोना स्थिर रहा क्योंकि व्यापारियों ने आगामी फेडरल रिजर्व दर वृद्धि पर अपने दांव कम किए। एक ही समय में, तेल की कीमतों में वृद्धि ने ट्रेजरी उपज को बढ़ा दिया।

items.text: The Taiwan dollar’s weakness led by global jitters over the artificial intelligence trade is masking the island’s underlying economic resilience that favors the currency’s rally into year-end, analysts say.
items.summary: The Taiwan dollar is weak because of global jitters over the artificial intelligence trade, but this hides the island’s underlying economic strength. Analysts say this resilience supports a year‑end rally for the currency.

items.title: Exporters may be asked to monitor supply chains' indirect emissions
items.text: The Indian government is engaging in discussions about measuring Scope 3 emissions for exporters. This consideration arises as trade partners impose tighter green requirements globally. Current frameworks focus on direct emissions and exclude indirect ones, making compliance more complex. As a result, industries, especially MSMEs, may face compliance burdens if new requirements are implemented. Ultimately, the aim is to ensure that Indian exporters remain competitive in international markets.
items.summary: The Indian government is discussing how to measure Scope 3 emissions for exporters as trade partners demand stricter green rules. Existing rules only cover direct emissions, leaving out indirect ones, which could raise compliance costs for industries, especially MSMEs. The goal is to keep Indian exporters competitive in global markets.

items.title: Q2 results 2026 today Oct 19 Monday: Hindustan Zinc, IREDA, L&T Tech, Union Bank among 35 firms to announce earnings
items.text: Indian benchmarks posted a second straight week of gains, with the Nifty and Sensex rising after a sharp recovery. Investors will watch quarterly earnings from 35 companies on October 19, including Bajaj Finance, Hindustan Zinc, UltraTech Cement and IREDA, as markets are expected to remain volatile.
items.summary: On October 19, 2026, Hindustan Zinc, IREDA, L&T Tech and Union Bank are among 35 companies set to announce their Q2 results. Indian benchmarks have risen for a second straight week, with the Nifty and Sensex up after a sharp recovery. Investors will watch these earnings as markets are expected to stay volatile.

items.title: Karnataka: Not a day goes by without Kumaraswamy taking aim at Congress and Shivakumar
items.text: Over the past few months, hardly a day has gone by without Kumaraswamy issuing statements, holding protests or raising fresh allegations against the state government. His attacks have intensified following Congress leader Siddaramaiah's police complaint seeking action against content linking him to an alleged honey-trap episode.
items.summary: Kumaraswamy has been issuing statements, holding protests and raising allegations against the Karnataka state government almost daily over recent months. His attacks grew stronger after Congress leader Siddaramaiah filed a police complaint seeking action against material linking him to an alleged honey‑trap case.
items.title_hi: कर्नाटक: एक दिन भी नहीं गुजरता जब कुमारस्वामी कांग्रेस और शिवकुमार पर निशाना साधते न हों
items.summary_hi: पिछले कुछ महीनों से कुमारस्वामी लगभग हर दिन बयान देते, प्रदर्शन करते और राज्य政府 पर नये आरोप लगाते रहे हैं। उनके हमले कांग्रेस नेता सिद्धरमैया द्वारा पुलिस शिकायत दर्ज करने के बाद बढ़ गये।

items.title: Farmers face 15% loss as poultry feed costs surge
items.text: Poultry farmers are currently experiencing losses of approximately 15% due to rising livestock feed costs. Key ingredients have seen price increases of up to 75%, affecting farmers' ability to cope. Dairy producers, particularly in drought-affected regions, struggle to source necessary fodder for their livestock. Feed manufacturers are also feeling the impact as higher prices reduce demand for their products.
items.summary: Poultry farmers are experiencing losses of approximately 15% due to rising feed costs, with key ingredient prices up by as much as 75%. Dairy producers in drought-affected areas struggle to obtain fodder, and feed manufacturers see lower demand as higher prices reduce purchases.
items.title_hi: किसान मुर्गी के चारे की लागत में वृद्धि के कारण 15% का नुकसान झेल रहे हैं
items.summary_hi: पोल्ट्री किसान चारे की बढ़ती लागत के कारण लगभग 15% का नुकसान झेल रहे हैं, जबकि प्रमुख सामग्रियों की कीमतें अधिकतम 75% तक बढ़ गई हैं। सूखा प्रभावित क्षेत्रों में दूध उत्पादकों को चारा प्राप्त करने में कठिनाई हो रही है, और फीड निर्माताओं को बढ़ी कीमतों के कारण मांग में कमी देखी जा रही है।

items.title: ED to seek Dubai's help via letters rogatory in probe against ex-Kerala CM, kin
items.text: ED's investigation centres on allegations that CMRL paid Exalogic Rs 2.78 crore under the guise of IT consultancy and related services despite allegedly receiving no corresponding services. The agency has alleged that the payments formed part of a wider arrangement involving illegal gratification to Vijayan during his tenure as chief minister. The allegations have not been established in court.
items.summary: The Enforcement Directorate is requesting assistance from Dubai through letters rogatory while investigating former Kerala Chief Minister Vijayan and his relatives. The probe alleges that CMRL paid Exalogic ₹2.78 crore for supposed IT consultancy even though no such services were reportedly received. It claims the payment was part of a larger scheme involving illegal gratification to Vijayan during his term as chief minister, though the allegations have not been proved in court.
items.title_hi: ईडी केरल के पूर्व मुख्यमंत्री और उनके रिश्तेदारों के खिलाफ जाँच में दुबई की मदद लेने के लिए letters rogatory का उपयोग करेगी
items.summary_hi: प्रवर्तन निदेशालय पूर्व केरल मुख्यमंत्री विजयन और उनके रिश्तेदारों के खिलाफ जाँच में दुबई से letters rogatory के माध्यम से मदद मांग रहा है। आरोप है कि CMRL ने Exalogic को ₹2.78 crore का भुगतान आईटी सलाहकार सेवाओं के नाम पर किया, जबकि कहा जाता है कि कोई ऐसी सेवा नहीं प्राप्त की गई। दावा किया गया कि यह भुगतान विजयान के मुख्यमंत्री के कार्यकाल के दौरान अवैध लाभ का हिस्सा था, हालांकि आरोप अदालत में स्थापित नहीं हुए।

items.title: Tiger Shroff Escapes Assassination Bid In Mumbai, 2 Suffer Gunshot Injuries
items.text: A video emerged in which a man called Anil Pandit, claiming to be from the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, said Tiger Shroff was on their hit list as "he was not heeding our directions" and "was working with Salman Khan".
items.summary: Tiger Shroff escaped an assassination attempt in Mumbai, while two individuals sustained gunshot wounds. A video showed a man named Anil Pandit, who said he belongs to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, claiming that Tiger Shroff was on their hit list because he did not follow their orders and was allegedly working with Salman Khan.

items.text: Tiger Shroff Assassination Bid Updates: A video soon emerged in which a man identifying himself as Anil Pandit, claiming to be from the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, said Tiger Shroff was on their hit list.

items.title_hi: टाइगर श्रॉफ हत्या प्रयास: संदिग्ध अंधेरी स्टेशन भाग गए, हमला बाइक बरामद की गई

items.title: Jantar Mantar chhoo-mantar, not protests
items.text: Jantar Mantar has recently been officially designated as a site for demonstrations in India. Jantar Mantar's transformation follows a history of protest locations like the Boat Club lawns. The change brought about noticeable effects on protest dynamics across the region. While protests do not fade away, they often shift in location based on official designations. Authorities face increased scrutiny to manage and maintain these designated sites appropriately.
items.summary: Jantar Mantar has been officially designated as a site for demonstrations in India. This follows a history of protest locations such as the Boat Club lawns. Authorities now face increased scrutiny to manage these designated sites.
items.title_hi: जantar मantar की मामली बात, प्रदर्शन नहीं

items.title: India vs China in 40 years: TRUST MF CIO Mihir Vora - 'India compounded GDP growth at 7.3%; China broke out at 11.3%'
items.text: TRUST Mutual Fund CIO Mihir Vora said India's GDP expanded 15.7-fold in 40 years, compared with China's 65.1-fold growth. He attributed the divergence to a gap in annualised growth rates and urged India to address obstacles to ease of doing business.
items.summary: TRUST Mutual Fund CIO Mihir Vora said India's GDP grew 15.7-fold in 40 years, while China's grew 65.1-fold. He noted India's compounded GDP growth at 7.3% and China's at 11.3%, attributing the difference to a gap in annualised growth rates and urging India to ease doing business obstacles.
items.title_hi: 40 वर्षों में भारत बनाम चीन: TRUST MF CIO Mihir Vora - 'भारत का चक्रवृद्धि जीडीपी वृद्धि 7.3%; चीन का विस्तार 11.3%'
items.summary_hi: TRUST Mutual Fund CIO Mihir Vora ने कहा कि भारत का जीडीपी 40 वर्षों में 15.7 गुना बढ़ा, जबकि चीन का 65.1 गुना बढ़ा। उन्होंने भारत के चक्रवृद्धि जीडीपी वृद्धि दर को 7.3% और चीन की को 11.3% बताया, वार्षिक वृद्धि दर में अंतर के कारण बताकर भारत से कारोबार करने में आसानी के लिए बाधाओं को हटाने की अपील की।

items.title: Global investors against use of judicial anti-avoidance rule by tax officials
items.text: International investors have raised concerns regarding the Indian Income-tax authorities' invocation of the judicial anti-avoidance rule. At a recent meeting, investors communicated their issues with the Central Board of Direct Taxes on this matter. The use of JAAR to deny relief on grandfathered shares contradicts prior regulations established by the CBDT. The standing of both GAAR and JAAR remains complex due to Supreme Court rulings.
items.summary: International investors have raised concerns about the Indian Income-tax authorities' use of the judicial anti-avoidance rule. They say that using JAAR to deny relief on grandfathered shares contradicts earlier CBDT regulations. The status of GAAR and JAAR remains complex because of Supreme Court rulings.

items.summary_hi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय निवेशकों ने भारतीय आयकर अधिकारियों के न्यायिक anti-avoidance नियम के उपयोग के बारे में चिंता जताई है। वे कहते हैं कि JAAR का उपयोग करके पुराने शेयरों पर राहत अस्वीकार करना पिछले CBDT नियमों के विपरीत है। GAAR और JAAR की स्थिति सुप्रीम कोर्ट के फैसलों के कारण जटिल बनी हुई है।

items.summary: Stubble burning occurs only during certain seasons, but air pollution persists throughout the year. Emissions from power plants and consistently high PM2.5 levels show that a wider clean‑air approach is needed. Therefore, blaming farm fires alone is insufficient.

items.text: India's merchandise exports grew across key regions in April-August FY27, with shipments to Africa rising 47% to $26.19 billion and ASEAN exports surging 56% to $23.08 billion.

items.title_hi: भारत के निर्यात में विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में वृद्धि हुई, जिसकी अगुवाई अफ्रीका और ASEAN ने की, Apr-Aug में
items.summary_hi: अप्रैल‑अगस्त FY27 में भारत की माल निर्यात प्रमुख क्षेत्रों में बढ़ी, अफ्रीका तक के निर्यात 47% बढ़कर $26.19 अरब तक पहुँचा। उसी अवधि में ASEAN तक के निर्यात 56% बढ़कर $23.08 अरब रहा।

items.title: Southern Railway introduces first Vistadome coach on Madurai-Guruvayur Express
items.text: Temporary trial from October 22, 2026 adds Executive AC Chair Car to the train’s composition on select days
items.summary: Southern Railway is introducing its first Vistadome coach on the Madurai-Guruvayur Express. A temporary trial starting October 22, 2026 will add an Executive AC Chair Car to the train on selected days.

items.title: Commerce, Finance Ministries at odds over future of key export support schemes
items.text: Commerce Department seeks five-year extension, but Finance Ministry remains unconvinced about their effectiveness; some exporters fear discontinuation
items.summary: The Commerce Department wants a five-year extension of key export support schemes. The Finance Ministry is not convinced that these schemes are effective. Some exporters worry that the schemes might be discontinued.
items.title_hi: वाणिज्य और वित्त मंत्रालय मुख्य निर्यात समर्थन योजनाओं के भविष्य को लेकर असहमत हैं
items.summary_hi: वाणिज्य विभाग मुख्य निर्यात समर्थन योजनाओं के लिए पांच साल का विस्तार चाहता है। वित्त मंत्रालय इन योजनाओं की प्रभावशीलता से आश्वस्त नहीं है। कुछ निर्यातक चिंतित हैं कि इन योजनाओं को बंद किया जा सकता है।

items.title: Reliance Jio IPO buzz reaches crypto market! Bitget launches Jio pre-IPO futures ahead of launch - Details for investors
items.text: Bitget has listed JIOUSDT, a 24/7 pre-IPO perpetual futures contract that lets traders speculate on Jio Platforms’ valuation without owning shares. The contract offers up to 20x leverage. Jio’s IPO is scheduled to open October 21, 2026, with a reported grey market premium of ₹250.
items.summary: Bitget has launched a 24/7 pre‑IPO perpetual futures contract called JIOUSDT that lets traders speculate on Jio Platforms’ value without buying shares. The contract provides up to 20x leverage. Jio’s IPO is set to open on October 21, 2026, with a grey‑market premium of ₹250.
items.title_hi: रिलायंस जियो आईपीओ की चर्चा क्रिप्टो बाज़ार तक पहुंची! बिटगेट ने जियो प्री‑आईपीओ फ्यूचर्स लॉन्च किए, लॉन्च से पहले - निवेशकों के लिए विवरण

items.title: India-New Zealand FTA to boost New Delhi's trade diversification strategy
items.text: The trade pact, effective Tuesday, offers duty-free access to Indian exports, targeted tariff concessions and a $20 billion investment commitment as both nations aim to double trade by 2030
items.summary: The India‑New Zealand free trade agreement, which took effect on Tuesday, will help New Delhi diversify its trade. It provides duty‑free entry for Indian exports, specific tariff reductions and a $20 billion investment pledge, with both countries aiming to double their trade by 2030.
items.title_hi: भारत-न्यूज़ीलैंड एफटीए नई दिल्ली के व्यापार विविधीकरण रणनीति को बढ़ावा देगा
items.summary_hi: भारत‑न्यूज़ीलैंड मुक्त व्यापार समझौता, जो मंगलवार को प्रभावी हुआ, नई दिल्ली के व्यापार को विविध बनाने में मदद करेगा। यह भारतीय निर्यात के लिए शुल्क‑मुक्त प्रवेश, लक्षित टैरिफ में कमी और $20 बिलियन के निवेश का वादा प्रदान करता है, दोनों देश 2030 तक अपना व्यापार दोगुना करने का लक्ष्य रखते हैं।

items.title: Drought conditions in 315 out of 621 mandals; Telangana seeks drought relief measures from Centre
items.text: The Minister stated that the ‘khet bachao abhiyan’ would be implemented in the State from October 22 to 30 with the national agricultural institutions and universities
items.summary: Drought conditions were reported in 315 of the 621 mandals in Telangana, prompting the state to seek relief measures from the central government. The minister said the ‘khet bachao abhiyan’ campaign will run from October 22 to 30, involving national agricultural institutions and universities.
items.title_hi: 621 मंडलों में से 315 में सूखा की स्थिति; तेलंगाना केंद्र से सूखा राहत उपाय मांग रहा है
items.summary_hi: तेलंगाना के 621 मंडलों में से 315 में सूखा की स्थिति रिपोर्ट की गई, जिससे राज्य ने केंद्र से राहत उपाय मांगे। मंत्री ने कहा कि ‘कhet बचाओ अभियान’ 22 अक्टूबर से 30 अक्टूबर तक चलेगा, जिसमें राष्ट्रीय कृषि संस्थान और विश्वविद्यालय शामिल होंगे।

items.title: Maharashtra drought: Farmer sends money order of ₹5,000 to CM over ‘paltry’ interim aid by govt.
items.text: “I cultivated a soybean crop on 1.5 acres of my farm. I spent ₹25,000 and received a 60-kg yield. I could earn just ₹3,900. I borrowed ₹1,100 from my friend to send the money order,” Mr. Shaikh told reporters outside Surdi post office.
items.summary: A farmer in Maharashtra sent a ₹5,000 money order to the chief minister, criticizing the interim aid as paltry. He said he cultivated soybeans on 1.5 acres, spent ₹25,000, harvested 60 kg, and earned only ₹3,900. To send the money order he borrowed ₹1,100 from a friend.
items.title_hi: महाराष्ट्र सूखा: किसान ने सरकार की ‘नगण्य’ अंतरिम मदद पर मुख्यमंत्री को ₹5,000 का मनी ऑर्डर भेजा
items.summary_hi: महाराष्ट्र के एक किसान ने मुख्यमंत्री को ₹5,000 का मनी ऑर्डर भेजा और अंतरिम मदद को नगण्य बताया। उन्होंने कहा कि उन्होंने 1.5 एकड़ पर सोयाबीन उगाया, ₹25,000 खर्च किए, 60 kg पैदावार प्राप्त की और केवल ₹3,900 कमाए। मनी ऑर्डर भेजने के लिए उन्होंने एक दोस्त से ₹1,100 उधार लिए।

items.summary_hi: विजयेंद्र ने कहा कि स्टिंग ऑपरेशन KPCC कार्यालय से विधान सौधा स्थानांतरित हो गए हैं। उन्होंने यह भी कहा कि मुख्यमंत्री D.K. शिवकुमार के खिलाफ असंतोष शुरू हो गया है, जैसा कि BJP राज्य अध्यक्ष ने बताया।

items.title: YSRCP’s call for President’s rule in Andhra Pradesh a political ploy, says TDP State president Palla Srinivasa Rao
items.text: It has been the opposition party’s habit to foment trouble for political gain and then shift the blame on the government, the TDP leader observes, while asserting that protecting democratic values and ensuring free and fair local body elections are on top of the government’s agenda
items.summary: TDP State president Palla Srinivasa Rao said YSRCP’s demand for President’s rule in Andhra Pradesh is merely a political tactic. He added that the opposition often stirs trouble to gain politically and then blames the government. Rao also noted that safeguarding democratic values and holding free, fair local body elections are top government priorities.
items.title_hi: YSRCP के आंध्र प्रदेश में राष्ट्रपति शासन की मांग को TDP राज्य अध्यक्ष पल्ला श्रीनिवास राव ने राजनीतिक चाल बताया
items.summary_hi: TDP राज्य अध्यक्ष पल्ला श्रीनिवास राव ने कहा कि YSRCP की आंध्र प्रदेश में राष्ट्रपति शासन की मांग सिर्फ एक राजनीतिक चाल है। उन्होंने कहा कि विपक्ष अक्सर राजनीतिक लाभ लेने के लिए परेशानी पैदा करता है और फिर सरकार को दोष देता है। राव ने यह भी बताया कि लोकतांत्रिक मूल्यों की रक्षा और निष्पक्ष, निःशुल्क स्थानीय निकाय चुनाव कराना सरकार की प्राथमिकता है।

items.title: India's services trade cushion faces pressure as imports outpace exports: ICICI Bank
items.text: The emerging concern is that faster growth in services imports could reduce the net foreign exchange earnings generated by India's services sector
items.summary: India's services trade cushion is under pressure because services imports are growing faster than exports. Faster growth in services imports could lower the net foreign exchange earnings from the services sector. This concern was highlighted by ICICI Bank.

items.title: Faster services imports threaten to erode cushion against India’s goods trade deficit: Report
items.text: India's services trade surplus has declined as imports grew faster than exports, leading to concerns about foreign exchange earnings. In September 2026, net services exports fell by 10 percent to USD 16.9 billion. Despite strong growth in merchandise exports of 23 percent, the services sector faces challenges. While cumulative net services exports increased during the first half, their sustainability is uncertain.
items.summary: Services trade surplus has fallen as services imports rose faster than exports. In September 2026, net services exports dropped 10 percent to USD 16.9 billion. Although merchandise exports grew 23 percent, the services sector faces challenges and the sustainability of earlier gains is uncertain.

items.title: Bajaj Finance Q2 preview: Profit may jump 29%, NII 24% as strong loan growth lifts earnings
items.text: Bajaj Finance is projecting a remarkable 29% increase in net profit for the July-September quarter, driven by robust loan demand and a boost in interest income. With a significant rise in assets under management, the demand for its lending products appears strong. Yet, analysts caution about potential pressure on lending margins owing to escalating borrowing costs.
items.summary: Bajaj Finance expects its net profit to rise about 29% in the July‑September quarter and its net interest income to increase around 24%. This outlook is based on strong loan growth, higher interest income and a significant rise in assets under management. Analysts warn that rising borrowing costs could pressure lending margins.
items.title_hi: बाजाज फाइनेंस Q2 पूर्वावलोकन: लाभ 29% बढ़ सकता है, NII 24% क्योंकि मजबूत ऋण वृद्धि आय को बढ़ा रही है
items.summary_hi: बाजाज फाइनेंस का अनुमान है कि जुलाई‑सितंबर तिमाही में उसका शुद्ध लाभ लगभग 29% बढ़ेगा और उसका शुद्ध ब्याज आय लगभग 24% बढ़ेगा। इस अनुमान के पीछे मजबूत ऋण मांग, ब्याज आय में वृद्धि और संपत्तियों के प्रबंधन में 상당한 वृद्धि है। विश्लेषकों ने चेतावनी दी कि बढ़ती उधार लेने की लागत से lending मार्जिन पर दबाव पड़ सकता है।
